items.title: 美AI晶片禁令升級！惠譽示警亞太AIDC融資趨緊 這類業者壓力最大
items.title_en: US AI Chip Ban Tightens: Fitch Warns Asia-Pacific AIDC Financing to Tighten, This Sector Faces Greatest Pressure
paras: 國際信評機構惠譽最新報告指出，隨著美國收緊對先進AI晶片及算力存取的管制，亞太地區資料中心投資將放緩並更趨審慎。其中，高度依賴中國客戶與美國先進晶片的新雲端業者（neocloud operators） ，因晶片取得與終端用戶受限導致營收能見度下降、新專案開發受阻，將面臨最嚴峻的信用與融資緊縮壓力。
美國商務部工業與安全局新規將管制從晶片出貨延伸至終端算力用戶，大幅推升短期執行風險。輸往馬來西亞、新加坡、印尼與泰國的受管制先進晶片需額外申請許可，向特定中企提供大量算力的海外資料中心亦納入規範，現有受影響合約須在90天內取得授權。
同時，市場傳出輝達 (NVDA-US)及代工夥伴已暫停部分對這四國的伺服器出貨以評估合規性，凸顯政策不確定性正延宕硬體交付、啟用與融資進度。
惠譽強調，新雲端業者將承受最直接的信用衝擊，因其現金流高度仰賴高昂的圖形處理器與合規客戶的高稼動率匹配。服務中企的業者若將算力折價轉租、改提供低階算力，或繼續使用現有輝達設備卻無法升級，皆會削弱營收、利潤率與競爭力，尤其以高槓桿且客源集中於中國的業者風險最高。
此外，即將完工的專案因常在開發後期才採購晶片與敲定客戶，硬體交付與客戶資格的不確定性恐導致部署與融資雙雙卡關。
相較之下，實體資料中心業主因透過長期合約提供電力空間、冷卻與網路連接，初期抗壓性較佳。監管限制並未免除租戶的付款義務，不可抗力條款則視個別合約而定。然而，若新雲端租戶營運長期疲軟，仍可能波及租金支付、續約率與出租率，使租戶集中度及產能重新配置能力成為關鍵信用指標。
東南亞專案未來將依客戶與工作負載而非地理位置加速分化。以馬來西亞為例，柔佛州同時匯聚美國超大規模雲端基礎設施、中資背景專案及終端客戶較不明確的批發產能；受管制客群比重高的專案恐面臨放緩或重組，但區域內整體產能不應被一概而論。
同時，東南亞各國政府將在維繫美國先進技術管道與吸引中企投資間面臨更艱難的平衡，嚴格執行終端用戶審查雖有助取得美方信任，卻可能削弱部分中資專案的吸引力，後續仍須觀察美中雙方的政策與商業應對。
融資環境將率先對晶片取得或客戶資格不明確的專案收緊，放款機構預期會加強盡職調查並延後撥款。惠譽強調，放款給擁有強大發起人與長約營收的實體資料中心，與融資給仰賴單一客群高稼動率的圖形處理器或新雲端業者風險截然不同，承購商實力、發起人追索權及合約保障將比單純的資料中心題材更受重視。
至於華為昇騰等中國替代晶片雖能隨時間緩解供應瓶頸，短期內仍難在海外設施快速取代輝達先進硬體，但美方禁令勢必加速中國投資國產晶片與替代性AI基礎設施，進而改變技術組合而非消滅潛在算力需求。
paras_en: Fitch, the international credit rating agency, noted in its latest report that as the United States tightens controls on access to advanced AI chips and computing power, investment in data centers across the Asia‑Pacific will slow and become more cautious. New cloud operators that heavily rely on Chinese customers and U.S. advanced chips face the steepest credit and financing squeeze as chip procurement and end‑user access restrictions dim revenue visibility and stall new project development.

The U.S. Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security has introduced a rule extending chip export controls to end‑user computing devices, sharply raising short‑term execution risk. Advanced chips shipped to Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia and Thailand now require additional licences, and overseas data centers that provide large amounts of compute to specific Chinese firms are also covered; existing affected contracts must obtain authorisation within 90 days.

At the same time, market reports say Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and its manufacturing partners have paused some server shipments to those four countries to assess compliance, highlighting how policy uncertainty is delaying hardware delivery, activation and financing timelines.

Fitch stresses that new cloud operators will feel the most direct credit hit because their cash flow depends heavily on expensive graphics processing units and on high utilisation rates from compliant customers. Operators serving Chinese firms that discount compute for sub‑leasing, shift to lower‑end compute, or continue using existing Nvidia equipment without upgrades will see revenue, margin and competitiveness erode, with the highest risk for highly leveraged firms whose customer base is concentrated in China.

Furthermore, projects that are near completion often purchase chips and lock in customers late in development, so uncertainty around hardware delivery and customer eligibility could block both deployment and financing.

By contrast, owners of physical data centres, who sell power, space, cooling and network connectivity under long‑term contracts, have better initial resilience. Regulatory limits do not relieve tenants of payment obligations, and force‑majeure clauses depend on individual contracts. Yet if new‑cloud tenants remain weak over the long term, rent payments, renewal rates and occupancy could suffer, making tenant concentration and the ability to re‑allocate capacity key credit metrics.

Southeast Asian projects will increasingly differentiate by customer type and workload rather than geography. In Malaysia, for example, Johor hosts a mix of massive U.S. cloud infrastructure, China‑backed projects and wholesale capacity with less‑clear end‑users; projects with a high share of regulated customers may face slowdown or restructuring, but regional overall capacity should not be painted with a broad brush.

Meanwhile, governments in Southeast Asia will face a tougher balance between maintaining pipelines for U.S. advanced technology and attracting Chinese investment. Strict end‑user vetting may earn U.S. trust but could dampen the appeal of some Chinese‑backed projects, and future developments will hinge on how the U.S. and China adjust policies and commercial strategies.

The financing environment will first tighten for projects with unclear chip access or customer eligibility, as lenders plan to intensify due‑diligence and delay disbursements. Fitch notes that lending to physical data centres with strong sponsors and long‑term revenue contracts is fundamentally different from financing new‑cloud operators that rely on a single customer base with high GPU utilisation; sponsor strength, sponsor recourse and contract protections will be weighted more heavily than the generic data‑centre narrative.

Although Chinese alternatives such as Huawei’s Ascend chips can ease supply bottlenecks over time, they are unlikely to quickly replace Nvidia’s advanced hardware in overseas facilities. Nonetheless, the U.S. ban will accelerate Chinese investment in domestic chips and alternative AI infrastructure, reshaping the technology mix rather than eliminating underlying compute demand.

items.title: 關稅恐跳至25%！美點名韓光州-全羅半導體聚落　三星、海力士擴產踩雷
items.title_en: Tariffs Could Rise to 25%! US Flags Gwangju‑Jeolla Semiconductor Cluster, Samsung and SK Hynix Expansion Hits a Snag
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，美國貿易代表辦公室(USTR)日前在一份194頁報告中特別點名南韓光州-全羅半導體聚落，釋放出對韓實施15%產能過剩關稅的信號，並警告根據談判結果稅率可能升至最高25%。
《首爾經濟日報》報導，南韓半導體業界人士認為，美方此舉是為要求三星電子(005930KS) 和SK海力士(000660KS)在美建設前端晶圓廠，進而加大SK海力士紐約州NAND工廠談判，以及三星德州泰勒DRAM投資負擔的可能性。
光州-全羅半導體聚落是南韓總統李在明推動的「三大超級項目」核心之一，打算在光州軍民兩用機場原址建設一個以三星和SK海力士四座半導體工廠為軸心的大型產業聚落，目標是在2030年前投入營運，將其打造為「韓國版矽谷」的基石。
今年10月9日，SK集團董事長崔泰源表示，正打算盡快在光州建設一個新的半導體產業聚落，押注於強勁成長的需求，但未透露具體開工時間。
崔泰源還說，龍仁半導體園區的建設進度從原定的2045年提前至2033年，屆時預計該集群將有四座工廠建成。龍仁半導體園區是SK海力士規模最大的生產基地。
今年6月，南韓政府在青瓦台舉行「三大超級項目」國民報告會，宣布由三星跟SK海力士在光州一帶共同投資約800兆韓元、建設4座最尖端晶圓廠，兩家公司各承擔一半、分別建設兩座工廠。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that the U.S. Trade Representative’s Office (USTR) recently singled out South Korea’s Gwangju‑Jeolla semiconductor cluster in a 194‑page report, signaling a possible 15% anti‑oversupply tariff on Korean chips and warning that, depending on negotiations, the rate could climb to as high as 25%.

The Seoul Economic Daily says industry insiders believe the move is intended to pressure Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) and SK Hynix (000660.KS) to build front‑end wafer fabs in the United States, thereby strengthening SK Hynix’s negotiations for a NAND plant in New York and increasing the financial burden of Samsung’s Texas‑based DRAM investment.

The Gwangju‑Jeolla semiconductor cluster is one of the three “super projects” championed by President Lee Jae‑myung, planned as a large industrial hub centered on four semiconductor factories from Samsung and SK Hynix on the former site of the Gwangju dual‑use military‑civilian airport, with operations slated to begin before 2030 and envisioned as the foundation of a “Korean Silicon Valley.”

On October 9 of this year, SK Group chairman Choi Tae‑won said the company is preparing to quickly build a new semiconductor industrial park in Gwangju, betting on strong demand growth, though he did not disclose a specific groundbreaking date.

Choi added that the construction schedule for the Yong‑in Semiconductor Park has been moved up from the originally planned 2045 completion to 2033, at which point the cluster is expected to have four factories operational. Yong‑in is SK Hynix’s largest production site.

In June, the South Korean government held a national briefing on the three super projects at the Blue House, announcing that Samsung and SK Hynix will jointly invest about 800 trillion won to build four cutting‑edge wafer fabs in the Gwangju area, with each company bearing half the cost and constructing two plants each.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉GTA6熱賣帶旺PS5買氣 宏碁遊戲明年拚雙位數成長今盤中亮燈漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: GTA 6 Sales Boost PS5 Demand, Acer Gaming Targets Double‑Digit Growth Next Year, Stock Hits Upper Limit at NT$25.2
paras: 受惠全球遊戲大作《俠盜獵車手6》帶動PlayStation 5主機買氣增溫，宏碁遊戲-創(6908-TW)昨日法說會釋出樂觀展望並看好明年營運挑戰雙位數成長，激勵今(27)日股價跳空開高並於盤中攻上漲停價25.2元，成交量較前一日放大。
宏碁遊戲總經理徐挺洋表示，俠盜獵車手6於11月19日正式上市後首日全球零售額達37.9億美元，目前遊戲軟體與相關主題手把在各地通路均呈現供不應求，公司正積極向原廠爭取12月及明年第一季貨源。隨著主機硬體、遊戲軟體、周邊配件及數位點數卡四大業務同步受惠，加上明年PS5平台仍有多款大作接力推出，公司目標2027年整體營收維持雙位數增長。
在區域代理布局方面，宏碁遊戲目前握有台灣、香港、新加坡及菲律賓四地的PlayStation獨家代理權，其中香港子公司更於今年11月取得當地全通路總代理權，擴大亞洲市場營運規模。公司也已在上述四地導入PlayStation Network數位業務，透過數位點數卡與限量版主題控制器等周邊商品，有效提升既有玩家重複消費並拓展硬體以外的營收來源。
展望中長期產業趨勢，宏碁遊戲參考前一代俠盜獵車手5橫跨三個主機世代並創下近2.35億套累計出貨的經驗，看好大型遊戲IP具備長達數年的長尾銷售效益。
paras_en: Benefiting from the global blockbuster Grand Theft Auto VI, which is heating up demand for PlayStation 5 consoles, Acer Gaming‑Creative (6908‑TW) released an optimistic outlook at its earnings briefing yesterday and expressed confidence in achieving double‑digit growth next year. The upbeat guidance lifted the stock at the open on the 27th, and it surged to the daily limit price of NT$25.2, with trading volume expanding from the previous day.

General Manager Xu Ting‑yang of Acer Gaming said GTA VI, launched on November 19, generated US$3.79 billion in retail sales on its first day worldwide. Game software and related themed controllers are currently out‑of‑stock across retail channels, and the company is actively negotiating with the publisher for additional shipments in December and the first quarter of next year. With the four business lines—hardware consoles, game software, peripherals and digital point‑card sales—benefiting simultaneously, and with several major titles slated for the PS5 platform next year, the company aims to maintain double‑digit revenue growth through 2027.

Regarding regional agency arrangements, Acer Gaming now holds exclusive PlayStation distribution rights in Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore and the Philippines. Its Hong Kong subsidiary secured full‑channel agency rights there in November, expanding the company’s Asian market footprint. The firm has also launched PlayStation Network digital services in these four markets, using digital point cards and limited‑edition themed controllers to boost repeat purchases among existing gamers and diversify revenue beyond hardware.

Looking at medium‑ to long‑term industry trends, Acer Gaming cites the experience of the previous generation GTA V, which spanned three console generations and shipped roughly 235 million units. The company believes large‑scale game IPs can generate a multi‑year “long‑tail” sales effect.

items.title: 軟銀5年內隱含違約機率升至34.8% AI回報疑慮燒進債市
items.title_en: SoftBank's 5-Year Implied Default Probability Rises to 34.8% as AI Return Concerns Spread to the Bond Market
paras: 軟銀五年期信用違約交換（CDS）利差週四(26日)升至534.6個基點，創2022年10月以來新高，市場報價隱含的五年內違約機率達34.8%。
軟銀集團重押人工智慧（AI），投資人愈來愈擔心，這些投資能否及時帶來足夠現金流，供集團償還債務。
軟銀被視為觀察AI投資前景的風向球，迄今已向OpenAI投入646億美元，最近一筆100億美元的資金來自9月發債。隨著軟銀舉債加碼OpenAI，債券投資人也愈來愈在意，AI業務究竟還要多久才能帶來收入。
這份疑慮在短短三週內明顯升高。11月6日，軟銀股價下跌10.8%，五年期CDS利差升至466個基點。
到了本週四，利差較當時再擴大近70個基點。當天軟銀股價在東京反彈7.3%，收復前一交易日14.83%的部分跌幅，違約保險成本卻連續第二天攀升。
大和證券資深策略師菅原正人表示，AI業務持續擴張的趨勢未變，但要將成長轉為實際收入，恐怕得花更長時間。對仰賴未來現金流償債的AI企業而言，收入來得愈晚，再融資也可能愈困難。
軟銀的美元債也反映出資金成本上升。集團9月發行創紀錄的111億美元高收益債，其中一檔美元債的票面利率達9.75%，是軟銀歷來發行美元債的最高票息。據彭博數據，該檔債券自發行以來，利差已擴大約四成，達到約644個基點。
標普全球早在3月就將軟銀的評等展望從「穩定」下調至「負向」，理由是追加投資OpenAI的300億美元可能削弱集團的流動性與信用品質。軟銀的長期發行人評等維持在非投資等級的BB+。
彭博產業研究認為，軟銀仍有時間透過出售資產，將調整後貸款價值比降至35%以下，以守住目前評等。
信用市場的壓力也延伸至AI基礎設施業者。10月中旬，甲骨文五年期CDS利差升至歷史新高288個基點，資料中心營運商CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 的CDS利差則突破1,000個基點。
美國期中選舉由民主黨大勝後，市場擔心AI基礎建設腳步放慢，舉債投入AI的企業也面臨CDS利差擴大的壓力。
paras_en: SoftBank's five‑year credit default swap (CDS) spread rose to 534.6 basis points on Thursday (the 26th), a peak not seen since October 2022, implying a five‑year default probability of 34.8% according to market pricing.

SoftBank Group has heavily bet on artificial intelligence (AI), and investors are increasingly worried whether these investments will generate enough cash flow in time for the group to service its debt.

SoftBank is seen as a bellwether for AI investment prospects; to date it has poured $64.6 billion into OpenAI, with the most recent $10 billion tranche coming from a September bond issuance. As SoftBank raises more debt to fund OpenAI, bond investors are paying closer attention to how long AI operations will take to produce revenue.
This concern has risen sharply over just three weeks. On November 6, SoftBank’s share price fell 10.8% and the five‑year CDS spread jumped to 466 basis points.

By Thursday of this week the spread had widened by another roughly 70 basis points. That day SoftBank’s stock rebounded 7.3% in Tokyo, recouping part of the 14.83% loss from the previous session, while the cost of default protection rose for the second consecutive day.

Masato Sugawara, a senior strategist at Daiwa Securities, said the trend of expanding AI operations remains unchanged, but turning that growth into actual revenue will likely take longer. For AI‑focused companies that rely on future cash flow to repay debt, delayed revenue makes refinancing increasingly difficult.

SoftBank’s dollar‑denominated bonds also reflect rising funding costs. In September the group issued a record‑high $11.1 billion high‑yield bond, with one tranche carrying a 9.75% coupon—the highest coupon SoftBank has ever issued on dollar debt. Bloomberg data show that since issuance the spread on that bond has widened by about 40%, reaching roughly 644 basis points.

S&P Global downgraded SoftBank’s rating outlook from “stable” to “negative” back in March, citing the $30 billion additional investment in OpenAI as a potential drain on the group’s liquidity and credit quality. SoftBank’s long‑term issuer rating remains at non‑investment‑grade BB+.
Bloomberg’s industry research believes SoftBank still has time to sell assets and bring its adjusted loan‑to‑value ratio below 35%, thereby preserving its current rating.

Credit‑market pressure is also spilling over to AI infrastructure providers. In mid‑October, Oracle’s five‑year CDS spread hit a historic high of 288 basis points, while data‑center operator CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) saw its CDS spread break the 1,000‑basis‑point mark.

After the U.S. midterm elections resulted in a strong Democratic victory, markets grew concerned that AI infrastructure spending could slow, putting additional pressure on CDS spreads for companies borrowing to fund AI initiatives.

items.title: 中國前10月工業企業利潤成長16%
items.title_en: China's Industrial Enterprises' Profits Grow 16% in First Ten Months
paras: 中國國家統計局27日公布的數據顯示，1～10月全國規模以上工業企業利潤總額為人民幣（下同）6.7373兆元，較一年前增長16%，10月工業企業利潤增加20.1%。
今年1～10月，規模以上工業企業中，國有控股企業利潤總額為2.108兆元，較去年同期成長13%；股份制企業利潤總額5.2426兆元，增長21.4%；外商及港澳台投資企業利潤總額1.4678兆元，增加0.2%；私營企業利潤總額1.7589兆元，增長11.4%。
國家統計局工業司首席統計師于衛寧說，1～10月全國工業生產總體平穩，新動能快速成長，帶動規模以上工業企業利潤成長16%，較1～9月加快0.5個百分點，今年以來繼續保持兩位數增長。
于衛寧提到，電子產業對利潤增長支撐作用明顯。人工智慧算力需求持續增加，帶動記憶體晶片和周邊製造等相關產業利潤持續增長。
于衛寧表示，下階段要全面貫徹落實黨中央、國務院決策，強化宏觀政策調節，進一步暢通經濟循環，不斷培育壯大工業領域新動能，持續鞏固工業經濟穩定運行基礎，推動工業經濟高品質發展。
paras_en: China's National Bureau of Statistics released data on the 27th showing that from January to October, the total profit of large-scale industrial enterprises nationwide amounted to RMB 6.7373 trillion, up 16% from a year earlier, with October alone seeing a 20.1% increase in industrial enterprise profits.

For the January‑October period, among large-scale industrial enterprises, state‑controlled firms posted total profits of RMB 2.108 trillion, a 13% rise year‑on‑year; joint‑stock companies earned RMB 5.2426 trillion, up 21.4%; foreign‑ and Hong‑Kong, Macau, Taiwan‑invested enterprises made RMB 1.4678 trillion, an increase of 0.2%; and private firms recorded RMB 1.7589 trillion in profit, up 11.4%.

Yu Weining, chief statistician of the Industrial Department at the National Bureau of Statistics, said that from January to October the country's overall industrial production remained stable, with new growth drivers expanding rapidly, driving a 16% profit increase for large‑scale industrial firms—0.5 percentage points faster than in January‑September—and that double‑digit growth has continued this year.

Yu noted that the electronics sector has clearly supported profit growth. Rising demand for AI computing power is boosting profits in related industries such as memory chips and peripheral manufacturing.

Yu said that the next stage will fully implement the decisions of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, strengthen macro‑policy regulation, further smooth economic cycles, continuously cultivate and expand new drivers in the industrial sector, solidify the foundation for stable industrial economic operation, and promote high‑quality development of the industrial economy.

items.title: 中韓記憶體廠拚技術！華為新HBM介面寬度達HBM4兩倍 長鑫秀新一代DDR5
items.title_en: China and South Korea Memory Makers Compete on Technology! Huawei's New HBM Interface Width Is Twice That of HBM4, ChangXin Showcases Next-Gen DDR5
paras: 華為、長鑫科技(688825-CN) 將在2027年國際固態電路會議（ISSCC）與三星電子(005930KS) 、SK海力士(000660KS) 同台較勁。
據南韓半導體媒體《The Elec》報導，華為將展示客製化高頻寬記憶體（HBM），資料介面寬度達4096位元，是HBM4標準的兩倍。長鑫則將發表32Gb DDR5晶片與新一代LPDDR6介面技術。
ISSCC 2027將於2月14日至18日在美國舊金山舉行。根據電機電子工程師學會（IEEE）公布的議程草案，華為深圳團隊預計於當地時間16日下午發表研究成果。
這款客製化HBM採用五層晶圓對晶圓（Wafer-on-Wafer）混合鍵合技術，整合64個記憶體通道與4096個資料接腳（DQ），並將負責DRAM讀寫的記憶體控制器納入HBM架構。
華為的設計之所以受到關注，在於更寬的介面能讓更多資料同時傳輸。HBM4標準的資料介面寬度為2048位元，華為將其加倍至4096位元，意味著即使單一接腳的傳輸速率較低，整體頻寬仍有機會與韓廠競爭。
以三星公布、單腳速率達17Gbps的HBM4E為例，有分析估算，若華為方案的單腳速率超過8.5Gbps，理論頻寬就有望超越三星這款產品。
除了加寬介面，華為也調整了記憶體控制器的位置。傳統HBM通常由多層DRAM晶片堆疊而成，透過底部的邏輯晶片與外部處理器交換資料。
華為將記憶體控制器直接整合進HBM，可望縮短控制邏輯與記憶體陣列之間的資料傳輸路徑，降低外部連接造成的延遲與耗電，也讓華為有更多空間，依特定AI處理器的需求設計記憶體架構。
在封裝方面，五層晶圓之間採用混合鍵合，可在有限面積內形成更密集的連接，縮短訊號傳輸路徑，也為堆疊更多層晶圓提供基礎。隨著AI處理器對記憶體頻寬與能源效率的要求提高，如何在堆疊晶片之間高效率傳輸資料，已成為HBM封裝技術的發展重點。
長鑫此次則聚焦兩項新一代DRAM研究。其中，容量為32Gb的DDR5晶片同樣採用混合鍵合技術，單腳傳輸速率達9.2Gbps。另一項成果為LPDDR6介面技術，傳輸速率達17.6Gbps。
本屆ISSCC共收到1029篇投稿，最終錄取274篇。中國、香港及澳門合計入選124篇，占45.3%，居各地區之首，美國與南韓分別有49篇及45篇入選。若單看此次中韓廠商同台競逐的記憶體領域，28篇入選論文中，南韓占12篇，中國占8篇。
paras_en: Huawei, ChangXin Technology (688825-CN) will compete on the same stage with Samsung Electronics (005930KS) and SK Hynix (000660KS) at the 2027 International Solid-State Circuits Conference (ISSCC).

According to South Korean semiconductor media The Elec, Huawei will showcase a custom high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) with a data interface width of 4096 bits, twice the HBM4 standard. ChangXin will present a 32‑Gb DDR5 chip and next‑generation LPDDR6 interface technology.

ISSCC 2027 will be held Feb 14‑18 in San Francisco, USA. According to the draft agenda released by the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE), Huawei’s Shenzhen team is scheduled to present its research on the afternoon of the 16th local time.

The custom HBM uses a five‑layer wafer‑on‑wafer hybrid bonding technique, integrating 64 memory channels and 4096 data pins (DQ), and incorporates the DRAM read/write controller into the HBM architecture.

Huawei’s design draws attention because the wider interface allows more data to be transferred simultaneously. The HBM4 standard’s data interface width is 2048 bits; Huawei doubles it to 4096 bits, meaning that even if the per‑pin transfer rate is lower, the overall bandwidth could still compete with Korean manufacturers.

Taking Samsung’s HBM4E, which advertises a per‑pin rate of 17 Gbps, analysts estimate that if Huawei’s solution achieves a per‑pin rate above 8.5 Gbps, its theoretical bandwidth could surpass Samsung’s product.

In addition to widening the interface, Huawei also relocated the memory controller. Traditional HBM typically consists of multiple stacked DRAM dies that exchange data with the external processor via a logic die at the bottom.

Huawei integrates the memory controller directly into the HBM, which could shorten the data path between control logic and the memory array, reduce latency and power consumption from external connections, and give Huawei more flexibility to design the memory architecture for specific AI processors.

In packaging, the hybrid bonding between the five wafer layers enables denser connections within a limited area, shortening signal paths and providing a basis for stacking more wafer layers. As AI processors demand higher memory bandwidth and energy efficiency, efficient data transfer between stacked chips has become a key focus of HBM packaging technology.

ChangXin’s focus this time is on two next‑generation DRAM research items. The 32‑Gb DDR5 chip also uses hybrid bonding and achieves a per‑pin transfer rate of 9.2 Gbps. The other result is an LPDDR6 interface technology with a transfer rate of 17.6 Gbps.

This ISSCC received 1,029 paper submissions, with 274 finally accepted. China, Hong Kong and Macau together had 124 papers selected (45.3%), the highest proportion, while the United States and South Korea had 49 and 45 papers respectively. Looking only at the memory papers where Chinese and Korean vendors compete, 28 papers were accepted, with South Korea accounting for 12 and China for 8.

items.title: 牛彈琴：這個建議一出 德國人吵翻了
items.title_en: Niu Danqin: This Suggestion Has Germans Up in Arms
paras: 世間最尷尬的場景，莫過於你昔日師傅當著你的面，把自己擺上貨架要給你。
反正，最近德國頂級經濟學家——基爾世界經濟研究所所長莫里茨·舒拉里克一個建議，震撼了整個德國和世界汽車界。
什麼建議？
舒拉里克的原話是：「趁著還能賣個好價錢，把沃爾夫斯堡的某家大型企業賣給中國人，也不失為一個好主意。」
某個大型企業是哪個？
赫赫有名的福斯汽車是也！
更具諷刺意味的是，發言現場，福斯汽車柏林代表處負責人邁克爾·揚森，就靜靜坐在聽眾席。
舒拉里克不是脫口秀演員。他執掌的基爾世界經濟研究所，被認為是德國歷史最悠久、最具影響力的經濟智庫。他說話時，也帶著一種精算師式平靜。
他的邏輯，也極其「經濟學」：在汽車製造領域，德國「現在已經是開發中國家了」，所以從德國角度出發，現在最關鍵的，不是福斯姓「德」還是姓「中」，而是「價值創造和生產活動能否留在德國」，至於生產設施歸誰所有，是「次要問題」。
具中國官方背景微信公眾號「牛彈琴」27日說，這話翻譯成大白話就是：廠子可以是你家的，但機器得在我家轉，工人得在我家領工資，至於老闆是誰，無所謂。
更有意思的是，他還補了一刀：歐洲應該允許中國電動車來賣，但要效仿當年中國合資車廠模式，用補貼規則倒逼中國車廠把生產線遷移至歐洲。
看來，德國人在努力向中國人學習啊！
「牛彈琴」說，當年手把手教中國的師傅，如今開始抄中國的作業——這大概就是時代最不動聲色的反轉。
現場一片譁然已經是很客氣的描述。真正炸鍋的，是德國汽車圈同行。
被譽為德國汽車經濟學「教皇」之一的費迪南德·杜登赫費爾，用一句德語俗語把舒拉里克懟了回去：這無異於「把貓頭鷹送往雅典」。
貓頭鷹在雅典遍地都是，用不著你千里迢迢送過去。
他的意思是，大眾的病根，早就寫在腦門上了，還用你一個經濟學家來「發現」？
杜登赫費爾越說越不客氣，乾脆把舒拉里克的方案翻譯成了清倉廣告：福斯、保時捷、奧迪、斯柯達、Cupra、MAN、斯堪尼亞，加上福斯商用車，「一攬子打包，賤賣給中國」，末了還補一句，「也許再搭幾家機械製造商」。
他用的那個德文詞「verhökern」，不是中性意義上的「出售」，而是帶著地攤甩貨味道的「賤賣」。
換做一句中國俗語：崽賣爺田不心疼。
另一位重量級人物、德國汽車管理中心主任斯特凡·布拉策爾的定性更短，也更重：把福斯賣給中國，是「工業政策上的投降」。
paras_en: The most awkward scene in the world is when your former master, right in front of you, puts himself on the shelf to be sold to you.
Anyway, a recent suggestion by Germany's top economist – Moritz Schularick, director of the Kiel Institute for the World Economy – has shaken the entire German and global automotive industry.
What is the suggestion?
Schularick’s exact words were: “While you can still get a good price, selling a large company in Wolfsburg to the Chinese is also a good idea.”
Which large company is it?
The world‑famous Volkswagen, of course!
Ironically, at the press conference, Michael Jansen, head of Volkswagen’s Berlin representative office, sat quietly in the audience.

Schularick is not a talk‑show host. He heads the Kiel Institute for the World Economy, regarded as Germany’s oldest and most influential economic think‑tank, and he speaks with the calm of an actuary.

His logic is extremely “economics‑driven”: in the automotive manufacturing sector, Germany is “already a developing country,” so from a German perspective the crucial issue now is not whether Volkswagen is “German” or “Chinese,” but whether “value creation and production activities can stay in Germany.” Who owns the production facilities is a “secondary issue.”

The China‑affiliated WeChat public account “Niu Danqin” explained on the 27th that, in plain language, the statement means: the factory can belong to you, but the machines must run in my country, the workers must be paid here, and it doesn’t matter who the boss is.

Even more interesting, he added a kicker: Europe should allow Chinese electric cars to be sold, but should mimic the old China‑joint‑venture model, using subsidy rules to force Chinese automakers to move their production lines to Europe.
It seems Germans are trying hard to learn from the Chinese!
“Niu Danqin” said that the masters who once taught the Chinese hand‑by‑hand are now copying China’s playbook – perhaps the most subtle reversal of the times.
Describing the scene as “a roar of protest” is actually an understatement. What really blew up were Schularick’s peers in the German automotive circle.
Ferdinand Dudenhöffer, hailed as one of the “pope” figures of German automotive economics, retorted with a German proverb: it’s like “sending an owl to Athens.”
Owls are everywhere in Athens; there’s no need to ship one over from afar.
His point was that the root of the problem is obvious to everyone, so why do you need an economist to “discover” it?

Dudenhöffer grew increasingly blunt, turning Schularick’s proposal into a clearance‑sale ad: Volkswagen, Porsche, Audi, Škoda, Cupra, MAN, Scania, plus Volkswagen commercial vehicles – “a whole bundle, sold cheap to China,” and he added, “maybe throw in a few more machinery manufacturers.”
The German word he used, “verhökern,” is not a neutral “sell,” but carries the connotation of a cheap, street‑vendor dump‑sale.
In Chinese slang it would be: “selling the calf’s field without a second thought.”
Another heavyweight, Stefan Braecher, head of the German Automotive Management Center, summed it up briefly but forcefully: selling Volkswagen to China is “a surrender in industrial policy.”

items.title: 〈焦點股〉GOGOLOOK有望朝一年賺一股本方向邁進 亮燈漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: GOGOLOOK Poised to Earn a Share Capital Per Year, Lights Up with Limit‑Up
paras: 防詐業者GOGOLOOK(6902-TW)表態看好AI代理(AI Agent)的發展帶動新需求，旗下AI 代理防護新產品「Agent Looker」明年有望取得初步成果，再加上今年消費端和企業端防詐需求大爆發，前三季已賺逾半個股本，法人樂觀看待未來2-3年GOGOLOOK將朝每年賺一個股本邁進，激勵今(27)日股價亮漲停燈。
AI自動駭客攻擊且監管逐漸嚴格，開始推動資安需求，GOGOLOOK 的新產品Agent Looker目標是將既有的龐大防詐知識庫與資料庫串接至AI代理，GOGOLOOK執行長郭建甫說，「AI主權的國家都會是我們未來可見的一些市場，包括日本、歐洲和東南亞等地」，期待明年開始會有一些成果，並在2028年後進入成長期開始貢獻營收。
郭建甫強調，AI的安全性議題較想像中巨大，AI找漏洞和攻擊能力遠比預期可怕，沒有任何公司可置身事外，因此，也帶動企業投資資安成為一大新趨勢，帶動龐大商機。
GOGOLOOK前三季每股大賺5.2元，主要因營運規模突破關鍵門檻(Critical Mass)帶動獲利同步放大，法人預估，由於GOGOLOOK營收可望逐年成長，在防詐和資安成長下，獲利同步上揚應無虞，不排除最快2-3年內就會達成一年賺超過一股本的新里程碑。
paras_en: Anti‑fraud company GOGOLOOK (6902‑TW) expressed optimism that AI Agent development will create new demand; its new AI agent protection product “Agent Looker” is expected to achieve initial results next year. Coupled with a huge surge in anti‑fraud demand from consumers and enterprises this year, it has earned more than half a share capital in the first three quarters. Institutional investors are optimistic that GOGOLOOK will move toward earning one share capital per year over the next 2–3 years, prompting the stock to hit the limit‑up today (27th).

AI‑driven automatic hacking attacks and increasingly strict regulations are spurring cybersecurity demand. GOGOLOOK's new product Agent Looker aims to connect its massive anti‑fraud knowledge base and database to an AI agent. CEO Guo Jianfu said, “Countries with AI sovereignty will be among our foreseeable markets, including Japan, Europe, and Southeast Asia.” He expects some results to start next year and that after 2028 the product will enter a growth phase and begin contributing revenue.

Guo emphasized that AI security issues are far larger than imagined; AI's ability to find vulnerabilities and attack is much scarier than expected, and no company can stay out of it. Consequently, corporate investment in cybersecurity is becoming a major new trend, driving huge business opportunities.

GOGOLOOK earned NT$5.2 per share in the first three quarters, mainly because its operating scale broke the critical‑mass threshold, amplifying profits. Institutional investors estimate that as GOGOLOOK's revenue is expected to grow year over year, profit should rise in tandem under anti‑fraud and cybersecurity growth, making it plausible to achieve the milestone of earning more than one share capital per year within the next 2–3 years.

items.title: 美AI晶片禁令升級！惠譽示警亞太AIDC融資趨緊 這類業者壓力最大
items.title_en: US AI Chip Ban Tightens: Fitch Warns Asia-Pacific AIDC Financing to Tighten, This Sector Faces Greatest Pressure
paras: 國際信評機構惠譽最新報告指出，隨著美國收緊對先進AI晶片及算力存取的管制，亞太地區資料中心投資將放緩並更趨審慎。其中，高度依賴中國客戶與美國先進晶片的新雲端業者（neocloud operators） ，因晶片取得與終端用戶受限導致營收能見度下降、新專案開發受阻，將面臨最嚴峻的信用與融資緊縮壓力。
美國商務部工業與安全局新規將管制從晶片出貨延伸至終端算力用戶，大幅推升短期執行風險。輸往馬來西亞、新加坡、印尼與泰國的受管制先進晶片需額外申請許可，向特定中企提供大量算力的海外資料中心亦納入規範，現有受影響合約須在90天內取得授權。
同時，市場傳出輝達 (NVDA-US)及代工夥伴已暫停部分對這四國的伺服器出貨以評估合規性，凸顯政策不確定性正延宕硬體交付、啟用與融資進度。
惠譽強調，新雲端業者將承受最直接的信用衝擊，因其現金流高度仰賴高昂的圖形處理器與合規客戶的高稼動率匹配。服務中企的業者若將算力折價轉租、改提供低階算力，或繼續使用現有輝達設備卻無法升級，皆會削弱營收、利潤率與競爭力，尤其以高槓桿且客源集中於中國的業者風險最高。
此外，即將完工的專案因常在開發後期才採購晶片與敲定客戶，硬體交付與客戶資格的不確定性恐導致部署與融資雙雙卡關。
相較之下，實體資料中心業主因透過長期合約提供電力空間、冷卻與網路連接，初期抗壓性較佳。監管限制並未免除租戶的付款義務，不可抗力條款則視個別合約而定。然而，若新雲端租戶營運長期疲軟，仍可能波及租金支付、續約率與出租率，使租戶集中度及產能重新配置能力成為關鍵信用指標。
東南亞專案未來將依客戶與工作負載而非地理位置加速分化。以馬來西亞為例，柔佛州同時匯聚美國超大規模雲端基礎設施、中資背景專案及終端客戶較不明確的批發產能；受管制客群比重高的專案恐面臨放緩或重組，但區域內整體產能不應被一概而論。
同時，東南亞各國政府將在維繫美國先進技術管道與吸引中企投資間面臨更艱難的平衡，嚴格執行終端用戶審查雖有助取得美方信任，卻可能削弱部分中資專案的吸引力，後續仍須觀察美中雙方的政策與商業應對。
融資環境將率先對晶片取得或客戶資格不明確的專案收緊，放款機構預期會加強盡職調查並延後撥款。惠譽強調，放款給擁有強大發起人與長約營收的實體資料中心，與融資給仰賴單一客群高稼動率的圖形處理器或新雲端業者風險截然不同，承購商實力、發起人追索權及合約保障將比單純的資料中心題材更受重視。
至於華為昇騰等中國替代晶片雖能隨時間緩解供應瓶頸，短期內仍難在海外設施快速取代輝達先進硬體，但美方禁令勢必加速中國投資國產晶片與替代性AI基礎設施，進而改變技術組合而非消滅潛在算力需求。
paras_en: Fitch, the international credit rating agency, noted in its latest report that as the United States tightens controls on access to advanced AI chips and computing power, investment in data centers across the Asia‑Pacific will slow and become more cautious. New cloud operators that heavily rely on Chinese customers and U.S. advanced chips face the steepest credit and financing squeeze as chip procurement and end‑user access restrictions dim revenue visibility and stall new project development.

The U.S. Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security has introduced a rule extending chip export controls to end‑user computing devices, sharply raising short‑term execution risk. Advanced chips shipped to Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia and Thailand now require additional licences, and overseas data centers that provide large amounts of compute to specific Chinese firms are also covered; existing affected contracts must obtain authorisation within 90 days.

At the same time, market reports say Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and its manufacturing partners have paused some server shipments to those four countries to assess compliance, highlighting how policy uncertainty is delaying hardware delivery, activation and financing timelines.

Fitch stresses that new cloud operators will feel the most direct credit hit because their cash flow depends heavily on expensive graphics processing units and on high utilisation rates from compliant customers. Operators serving Chinese firms that discount compute for sub‑leasing, shift to lower‑end compute, or continue using existing Nvidia equipment without upgrades will see revenue, margin and competitiveness erode, with the highest risk for highly leveraged firms whose customer base is concentrated in China.

Furthermore, projects that are near completion often purchase chips and lock in customers late in development, so uncertainty around hardware delivery and customer eligibility could block both deployment and financing.

By contrast, owners of physical data centres, who sell power, space, cooling and network connectivity under long‑term contracts, have better initial resilience. Regulatory limits do not relieve tenants of payment obligations, and force‑majeure clauses depend on individual contracts. Yet if new‑cloud tenants remain weak over the long term, rent payments, renewal rates and occupancy could suffer, making tenant concentration and the ability to re‑allocate capacity key credit metrics.

Southeast Asian projects will increasingly differentiate by customer type and workload rather than geography. In Malaysia, for example, Johor hosts a mix of massive U.S. cloud infrastructure, China‑backed projects and wholesale capacity with less‑clear end‑users; projects with a high share of regulated customers may face slowdown or restructuring, but regional overall capacity should not be painted with a broad brush.

Meanwhile, governments in Southeast Asia will face a tougher balance between maintaining pipelines for U.S. advanced technology and attracting Chinese investment. Strict end‑user vetting may earn U.S. trust but could dampen the appeal of some Chinese‑backed projects, and future developments will hinge on how the U.S. and China adjust policies and commercial strategies.

The financing environment will first tighten for projects with unclear chip access or customer eligibility, as lenders plan to intensify due‑diligence and delay disbursements. Fitch notes that lending to physical data centres with strong sponsors and long‑term revenue contracts is fundamentally different from financing new‑cloud operators that rely on a single customer base with high GPU utilisation; sponsor strength, sponsor recourse and contract protections will be weighted more heavily than the generic data‑centre narrative.

Although Chinese alternatives such as Huawei’s Ascend chips can ease supply bottlenecks over time, they are unlikely to quickly replace Nvidia’s advanced hardware in overseas facilities. Nonetheless, the U.S. ban will accelerate Chinese investment in domestic chips and alternative AI infrastructure, reshaping the technology mix rather than eliminating underlying compute demand.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉GTA6熱賣帶旺PS5買氣 宏碁遊戲明年拚雙位數成長今盤中亮燈漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: GTA 6 Sales Boost PS5 Demand, Acer Gaming Targets Double‑Digit Growth Next Year, Stock Hits Upper Limit at NT$25.2
paras: 受惠全球遊戲大作《俠盜獵車手6》帶動PlayStation 5主機買氣增溫，宏碁遊戲-創(6908-TW)昨日法說會釋出樂觀展望並看好明年營運挑戰雙位數成長，激勵今(27)日股價跳空開高並於盤中攻上漲停價25.2元，成交量較前一日放大。
宏碁遊戲總經理徐挺洋表示，俠盜獵車手6於11月19日正式上市後首日全球零售額達37.9億美元，目前遊戲軟體與相關主題手把在各地通路均呈現供不應求，公司正積極向原廠爭取12月及明年第一季貨源。隨著主機硬體、遊戲軟體、周邊配件及數位點數卡四大業務同步受惠，加上明年PS5平台仍有多款大作接力推出，公司目標2027年整體營收維持雙位數增長。
在區域代理布局方面，宏碁遊戲目前握有台灣、香港、新加坡及菲律賓四地的PlayStation獨家代理權，其中香港子公司更於今年11月取得當地全通路總代理權，擴大亞洲市場營運規模。公司也已在上述四地導入PlayStation Network數位業務，透過數位點數卡與限量版主題控制器等周邊商品，有效提升既有玩家重複消費並拓展硬體以外的營收來源。
展望中長期產業趨勢，宏碁遊戲參考前一代俠盜獵車手5橫跨三個主機世代並創下近2.35億套累計出貨的經驗，看好大型遊戲IP具備長達數年的長尾銷售效益。
paras_en: Benefiting from the global blockbuster Grand Theft Auto VI, which is heating up demand for PlayStation 5 consoles, Acer Gaming‑Creative (6908‑TW) released an optimistic outlook at its earnings briefing yesterday and expressed confidence in achieving double‑digit growth next year. The upbeat guidance lifted the stock at the open on the 27th, and it surged to the daily limit price of NT$25.2, with trading volume expanding from the previous day.

General Manager Xu Ting‑yang of Acer Gaming said GTA VI, launched on November 19, generated US$3.79 billion in retail sales on its first day worldwide. Game software and related themed controllers are currently out‑of‑stock across retail channels, and the company is actively negotiating with the publisher for additional shipments in December and the first quarter of next year. With the four business lines—hardware consoles, game software, peripherals and digital point‑card sales—benefiting simultaneously, and with several major titles slated for the PS5 platform next year, the company aims to maintain double‑digit revenue growth through 2027.

Regarding regional agency arrangements, Acer Gaming now holds exclusive PlayStation distribution rights in Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore and the Philippines. Its Hong Kong subsidiary secured full‑channel agency rights there in November, expanding the company’s Asian market footprint. The firm has also launched PlayStation Network digital services in these four markets, using digital point cards and limited‑edition themed controllers to boost repeat purchases among existing gamers and diversify revenue beyond hardware.

Looking at medium‑ to long‑term industry trends, Acer Gaming cites the experience of the previous generation GTA V, which spanned three console generations and shipped roughly 235 million units. The company believes large‑scale game IPs can generate a multi‑year “long‑tail” sales effect.

items.title: 聯嘉連5年拿TCSA台灣企業永續獎 更首度獲「性別平等領袖獎」
items.title_en: Lianjia Wins TCSA Taiwan Corporate Sustainability Award for Fifth Consecutive Year, First Time Securing the Gender Equality Leadership Award
paras: 有「台灣企業永續奧斯卡」美譽的《TCSA台灣企業永續獎》公布2026年評選成果，本屆共吸引773家企業與組織參與，聯嘉光電投控(3717-TW)在其中脫穎而出，連續第五年獲獎，除了再度蟬聯「台灣百大永續典範企業」和「永續報告書金獎」，並首次拿下「性別平等領袖獎」，肯定聯嘉在女性人才培育和多元共融職場的投入。
聯嘉在總經理黃昉鈺推動下，透過職涯需求調查、女性賦能論壇和「EOI女性專業經理人成長社」，結合領導力培訓、經驗傳承與同儕交流，支持女性同仁發展專業、承擔管理職責，並將人權與性別平等理念延伸至供應鏈夥伴。
黃昉鈺為台灣科學園區同業公會中少數的女性理事，曾擔任光電產業召集人，代表產業赴總統府向總統及執政團隊提出建言，從企業經營、人才培育到產業政策交流，展現女性企業領導人對台灣科技產業的付出與貢獻。
聯嘉以「智慧減碳、責任共擔、生態共好」為方向，持續深化碳管理與供應鏈協作，關注員工權益、職場安全和生物多樣性保育，並精進永續資訊揭露，此次再獲三項殊榮，是全體同仁跨部門合作、長期投入的共同成果。
展望2027年，聯嘉表示，將持續推動低碳轉型、女性人才培育與責任供應鏈合作，讓企業成長與人才發展相互支持。
paras_en: The “TCSA Taiwan Corporate Sustainability Award,” dubbed the “Oscars of Taiwan corporate sustainability,” announced its 2026 results, attracting 773 companies and organizations. Lianjia Optoelectronics Holding (3717‑TW) stood out, winning for the fifth straight year. In addition to retaining its titles as a “Top 100 Sustainable Model Enterprise in Taiwan” and a “Gold Award for Sustainability Report,” it earned the “Gender Equality Leadership Award” for the first time, recognizing its investment in female talent development and an inclusive workplace.

Under the leadership of General Manager Huang Fang‑Yu, Lianjia conducted career‑needs surveys, hosted women‑empowerment forums, and created the “EOI Women Professional Managers Growth Community.” These initiatives combine leadership training, mentorship, and peer exchange to support female staff in developing expertise, taking on managerial roles, and extending human‑rights and gender‑equality principles to supply‑chain partners.

Huang Fang‑Yu is one of the few female directors in the Taiwan Science Park Industry Association and has served as a convenor for the optoelectronics sector. She has represented the industry at the Presidential Office, offering recommendations to the president and the administration on corporate management, talent cultivation, and industry‑policy dialogue, showcasing the contributions of female business leaders to Taiwan’s technology sector.

Lianjia’s strategy of “smart carbon reduction, shared responsibility, and ecological harmony” drives deeper carbon management and supply‑chain collaboration, while focusing on employee rights, workplace safety, and biodiversity conservation. Continued improvement in sustainability disclosure earned the company three more honors this year, reflecting the cross‑departmental teamwork and long‑term commitment of all staff.

Looking ahead to 2027, Lianjia says it will keep advancing low‑carbon transformation, women‑talent development, and responsible supply‑chain cooperation, ensuring that corporate growth and talent development reinforce each other.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉GOGOLOOK有望朝一年賺一股本方向邁進 亮燈漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: GOGOLOOK Poised to Earn a Share Capital Per Year, Lights Up with Limit‑Up
paras: 防詐業者GOGOLOOK(6902-TW)表態看好AI代理(AI Agent)的發展帶動新需求，旗下AI 代理防護新產品「Agent Looker」明年有望取得初步成果，再加上今年消費端和企業端防詐需求大爆發，前三季已賺逾半個股本，法人樂觀看待未來2-3年GOGOLOOK將朝每年賺一個股本邁進，激勵今(27)日股價亮漲停燈。
AI自動駭客攻擊且監管逐漸嚴格，開始推動資安需求，GOGOLOOK 的新產品Agent Looker目標是將既有的龐大防詐知識庫與資料庫串接至AI代理，GOGOLOOK執行長郭建甫說，「AI主權的國家都會是我們未來可見的一些市場，包括日本、歐洲和東南亞等地」，期待明年開始會有一些成果，並在2028年後進入成長期開始貢獻營收。
郭建甫強調，AI的安全性議題較想像中巨大，AI找漏洞和攻擊能力遠比預期可怕，沒有任何公司可置身事外，因此，也帶動企業投資資安成為一大新趨勢，帶動龐大商機。
GOGOLOOK前三季每股大賺5.2元，主要因營運規模突破關鍵門檻(Critical Mass)帶動獲利同步放大，法人預估，由於GOGOLOOK營收可望逐年成長，在防詐和資安成長下，獲利同步上揚應無虞，不排除最快2-3年內就會達成一年賺超過一股本的新里程碑。
paras_en: Anti‑fraud company GOGOLOOK (6902‑TW) expressed optimism that AI Agent development will create new demand; its new AI agent protection product “Agent Looker” is expected to achieve initial results next year. Coupled with a huge surge in anti‑fraud demand from consumers and enterprises this year, it has earned more than half a share capital in the first three quarters. Institutional investors are optimistic that GOGOLOOK will move toward earning one share capital per year over the next 2–3 years, prompting the stock to hit the limit‑up today (27th).

AI‑driven automatic hacking attacks and increasingly strict regulations are spurring cybersecurity demand. GOGOLOOK's new product Agent Looker aims to connect its massive anti‑fraud knowledge base and database to an AI agent. CEO Guo Jianfu said, “Countries with AI sovereignty will be among our foreseeable markets, including Japan, Europe, and Southeast Asia.” He expects some results to start next year and that after 2028 the product will enter a growth phase and begin contributing revenue.

Guo emphasized that AI security issues are far larger than imagined; AI's ability to find vulnerabilities and attack is much scarier than expected, and no company can stay out of it. Consequently, corporate investment in cybersecurity is becoming a major new trend, driving huge business opportunities.

GOGOLOOK earned NT$5.2 per share in the first three quarters, mainly because its operating scale broke the critical‑mass threshold, amplifying profits. Institutional investors estimate that as GOGOLOOK's revenue is expected to grow year over year, profit should rise in tandem under anti‑fraud and cybersecurity growth, making it plausible to achieve the milestone of earning more than one share capital per year within the next 2–3 years.

items.title: 泰金-KY前3季每股賺9.03元 上半年股息4.8元訂12/28除息
items.title_en: Tai Jin-KY Posts Q1‑Q3 EPS of NT$9.03; H1 Dividend of NT$4.8 Scheduled for Ex‑Date Dec 28
paras: 家飾鑄件廠泰金-KY(6629-TW) 2026年1-3季稅後純益3.47億元，年增1.11倍，每股純益達9.03元，較去年同期4.28元明顯成長，同時，泰金-KY董事會決議2026年上半年股息配發4.8元，訂12月28日交易。
泰金-KY將配息4.8，以今天開盤價98元計算，半年度殖利率已達4.9%。
泰金-KY在2026年第三季營收5.87億元，毛利率24.44%，季增0.01個百分點，年減2.04個百分點，稅後純益9892萬元，季減10.27%，年減7.85%，每股純益2.58元。
同時，泰金-KY在2026年1-3季營收19.38億元，較去年同期成長68.26%，毛利率23.42%，年減6.62個百分點，稅後稅後純益3.47億元，年增1.11倍，每股純益達9.03元。
泰金-KY過去以家飾外觀件為產品主軸，主要客戶為美系國際知名品牌及通路業者，產品涵蓋櫥櫃五金、衛浴配件及窗飾五金。自2025年第四季投入水五金產品代工後，今年持續貢獻營收，加上新產品及新客戶的加入，帶動前三季營收規模較去年同期顯著擴大。隨著產品組合改變，前三季毛利率雖低於去年同期30.04%，但營收成長仍帶動營業毛利及營業淨利同步增加。
泰金-KY在2026年第三季單季營收5.87億元，較去年同期成長32.60%，較第二季減少10.17%；營業毛利1.44億元，年增22.41%；營業淨利1.15億元，年增19.17%。歸屬母公司稅後淨利為9892萬元，每股盈餘2.58元，單季營業利益較去年同期有所成長，業外因匯兌利益較去年減少，造成稅後純益較去年同期下降。。
泰金-KY表示，第三季金屬原物料成本上升幅度較大，對生產成本形成壓力。在此情況下，第三季毛利率仍維持24.44%，與第二季24.43%大致持平，惟低於去年同期26.48%。展望後續營運，金屬原物料成本走勢及匯率變動，以及北美房地產景氣是否回溫，仍是影響獲利表現的重要因素。
paras_en: Home décor casting manufacturer Tai Jin-KY (6629‑TW) reported Q1‑Q3 2026 after‑tax net profit of NT$347 million, up 1.11‑fold year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$9.03, up from NT$4.28 in the same period last year. The board also resolved to distribute a dividend of NT$4.8 for the first half of 2026, with the ex‑date set for December 28.
With a dividend of NT$4.8 and a opening price of NT$98 today, the semi‑annual yield reaches 4.9%.

In Q3 2026, Tai Jin-KY recorded revenue of NT$5.87 billion, gross margin 24.44%, up 0.01 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter but down 2.04 percentage points year‑over‑year. After‑tax net profit was NT$98.92 million, down 10.27% quarter‑over‑quarter and 7.85% year‑over‑year, yielding EPS of NT$2.58.

In the first three quarters of 2026, revenue was NT$19.38 billion, a 68.26% increase from the same period last year. Gross margin was 23.42%, down 6.62 percentage points year‑over‑year. After‑tax net profit was NT$347 million, up 1.11‑fold year‑over‑year, with EPS of NT$9.03.

Tai Jin-KY has traditionally focused on home‑decor hardware, serving major U.S. international brands and retail channels with products such as cabinet fittings, bathroom accessories and window hardware. After entering water‑hardware OEM in Q4 2025, the segment continued to contribute to revenue this year; together with new products and customers, it drove a significant expansion of Q1‑Q3 revenue compared with last year. Although the product mix shift lowered the Q1‑Q3 gross margin by 30.04 percentage points versus last year, the revenue growth still lifted both operating gross profit and operating net profit.

In Q3 2026, single‑quarter revenue was NT$5.87 billion, up 32.60% year‑over‑year but down 10.17% from Q2. Operating gross profit was NT$1.44 billion, up 22.41% year‑over‑year; operating net profit was NT$1.15 billion, up 19.17% year‑over‑year. Net profit attributable to the parent was NT$98.92 million, EPS NT$2.58. Operating profit grew versus last year, while non‑operating foreign‑exchange gains fell, causing after‑tax profit to decline versus the same period last year.

Tai Jin-KY said metal raw‑material costs rose sharply in Q3, pressuring production costs. Nevertheless, Q3 gross margin held at 24.44%, essentially unchanged from Q2’s 24.43% but below last year’s 26.48%. Looking ahead, the trajectory of metal raw‑material prices, exchange‑rate movements, and the health of the North American real‑estate market will remain key factors affecting profitability.

items.title: 超豐營收增四成、營業利益增166%毛利率站上三成
items.title_en: Superfine's Revenue Rises 40%, Operating Profit Jumps 166% as Gross Margin Tops 30%
paras: 2026年11月27日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 封測廠超豐(2441-TW)第三季合併營收59.98億元，年增41.1%，營業利益大增166.4%至15.85億元，每股盈餘由去年同期1.31元升至2.44元。10月營收達20.06億元，年增36.0%，維持第三季以來的銷售水準。
超豐本業獲利增速遠高於營收，關鍵在於營業成本只增加20.7%，約為營收增幅的一半，帶動毛利率由去年同期18.26%升至30.09%。同期營業費用率下降0.60個百分點，營業利益率由14.00%升至26.42%，改善主要來自毛利率。第三季業外收益則由2.45億元降至1.35億元。
超豐在7月法說會指出，上半年毛利率改善，來自產能利用率提高、產品組合調整及平均售價上升，新台幣貶值也有貢獻。公司當時表示，AI與高效能運算需求帶動凸塊製程及覆晶封裝接單；第三季各因素分別挹注多少毛利，公司並未量化。
接下來看覆晶封裝新設備何時轉成出貨。超豐7月估計，若設備順利到位，第四季後覆晶封裝月產能可由約2.1億顆增至2.3億顆，滿載月營收估由2.6億元增至3.2億元。公司10月另公告，7月至10月累計向應用材料採購約6.59億元的電鍍設備及零配件。

paras_en: Nov 27, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Test‑chip packaging firm Superfine (2441‑TW) reported third‑quarter consolidated revenue of NT$5.998 billion, up 41.1% year‑over‑year, and operating profit surged 166.4% to NT$1.585 billion, with earnings per share climbing from NT$1.31 last year to NT$2.44. October revenue reached NT$2.006 billion, a 36.0% annual increase, maintaining the sales level seen since Q3.

Superfine’s core business profit grew far faster than revenue because operating costs rose only 20.7%, roughly half the revenue growth rate, lifting gross margin from 18.26% a year ago to 30.09%. Operating expense ratio fell by 0.60 percentage points, and operating profit margin rose from 14.00% to 26.42%, the improvement driven mainly by the higher gross margin. Non‑operating income in Q3 fell from NT$245 million to NT$135 million.

In its July earnings briefing, Superfine said the first‑half gross margin improvement stemmed from higher capacity utilization, a better product mix and higher average selling prices, with the depreciation of the New Taiwan dollar also contributing. The company noted that AI and high‑performance computing demand boosted orders for bump‑up processes and wafer‑level packaging, but did not quantify how much each factor added to margin in Q3.

Looking ahead to when new wafer‑level packaging equipment will translate into shipments, Superfine estimated in July that if the equipment arrives on schedule, monthly wafer‑level packaging capacity could rise from about 210 million units to 230 million units after Q4, raising full‑load monthly revenue from NT$2.6 billion to NT$3.2 billion. In October the company also announced that from July to October it had purchased roughly NT$6.59 billion of electroplating equipment and parts from Applied Materials.

items.title_en: Is the Taiwan Stock Market Really Finished? Unveiling Four Bottom‑Finding Signals! Which Strong Stocks Are Hidden for a December Rally?
paras: 最近台股上演大怒神戲碼！很多個股震盪劇烈，一天漲停、隔天跌停，江江認為，與其每天被市場漲跌牽動情緒，不如掌握四大客觀指標，找出行情真正的轉折契機！
第一、融資大清洗，籌碼逐步沉澱

paras_en: Recently the Taiwan stock market has been putting on a dramatic roller‑coaster show! Many stocks are wildly volatile, hitting a limit‑up one day and a limit‑down the next. Jiang Jiang believes that instead of letting daily market swings dictate your emotions, you should focus on four objective indicators to pinpoint the true turning point of the market.
First, a massive margin‑financing clean‑up, with capital gradually settling.

This sharp drop in the Taiwan market has washed out a large amount of floating capital. As margin financing retreats and selling pressure eases, it helps form a mid‑term bottom. However, capital clean‑up is only a necessary condition for a bottom; it still needs to be confirmed by a technical rebound.
Second, the three major bearish concerns are gradually cooling off.

U.S. Vice President Fans (likely a typo for Vice President Harris) said that, according to the Justice Department and national security officials, Jensen Huang is not under any related federal investigation, so the pardon speculation has temporarily subsided; the latest U.S. draft 301 tariff proposal places Taiwan in the same 15% minimum, non‑cumulative tariff tier as Japan, South Korea and the EU.

More importantly, Dell (DELL‑US) reported new AI‑server orders for the quarter totaling $60.2 billion, with undelivered orders reaching $132.3 billion – a historic high! While the stock price has plunged, the order surge shows that AI demand still carries strong growth momentum.
Third, the bullish counter‑attack still needs one more tailwind: a stronger New Taiwan dollar.

Foreign investors’ net short positions on the Taiwan index futures remain above 100,000 contracts. If the NT$ can break above 32.88 per U.S. $, combined with foreign investors covering spot positions and reducing futures shorts, a powerful rally and short‑covering squeeze could emerge.
Fourth, in early December watch for a monthly‑line pull‑back that could trigger a turning point.

The four‑step bottom pattern: “sharp drop, floor, upward gap, moving‑average crossover!” Next, watch whether a solid support forms around the 37,000‑point level and whether the 40,000‑point resistance can be cleanly broken. In early December, as the monthly‑line pull‑back value changes, a sustained rise in the index would help flatten the monthly line and then push it higher.
As for stock selection, Jiang Jiang believes five major industries are worth digging into.
First, PCB/CCL: computing‑power upgrades driving both volume and price higher.

If AI chips are the engine of a sports car, high‑end PCBs and CCLs are the chassis and the high‑speed highway. The stronger the computing power, the higher the demand for board specifications and high‑speed transmission. Xinxing (3037‑TW) posted October revenue of NT$18.986 billion, up 67.62% YoY. As GPU and ASIC server specs keep advancing, Nan‑Dian (8046‑TW), Taiwan‑Optoelectronics (2383‑TW), Lian‑Mao (6213‑TW), Jin‑Xiang‑Dian (2368‑TW) and Jianding (3044‑TW) all have growth opportunities from an increasing share of high‑end products.
Second, the cooling‑solution segment: rising liquid‑cooling penetration opens profit space.

Computing power can keep climbing, but heat cannot accumulate indefinitely! Qihong (3017‑TW) saw Q3 revenue rise 51.8% YoY and net profit jump 116.6% YoY, with EPS for the first three quarters reaching NT$73.86. It plans to expand liquid‑cooling capacity by more than 50% by 2027. Companies such as Jiance (3653‑TW), Gaoli (8996‑TW) and Fushida (6805‑TW) benefit not only from higher server shipments but also from the added value of cooling each rack unit.
Third, low‑earth‑orbit satellites: the next high‑growth blue‑ocean industry.

Global satellite deployment is expanding, and new‑generation satellite upgrades, direct‑to‑phone satellite links, and space data centers are creating fresh market opportunities. Sheng‑Da‑Ke (3491‑TW) posted a 207% YoY increase in Q3 net profit, though investors should watch product transitions and launch schedules. Suppliers such as Huatong (2313‑TW), Tong‑Xin‑Dian (6271‑TW) and Qiqi (6285‑TW) are also worth tracking for the medium‑ to long‑term.
Fourth, AI chips and power supplies: the national‑strategic growth engine remains lit.

Whether GPU or ASIC, competition always hinges on advanced processes and high‑efficiency power. TSMC (2330‑TW) holds the advanced‑process advantage, MediaTek (2454‑TW) is actively building AI ASICs, and Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) reported October revenue of NT$74.666 billion, up 30.1% YoY – a new record. Although stock prices have corrected, the core competitiveness of these firms may not change.
Fifth, key server components: the silent champions making big money behind the scenes.

In a gold‑rush, the people selling shovels can also get rich! Chuan‑Hu (2059‑TW) captures the high‑end server rail market, while Mao‑Lian‑KY (3665‑TW) benefits from AI demand and merger synergies, posting an 80% YoY revenue increase in October and Q3 EPS of NT$21.93, a quarterly high. Yageo (2327‑TW), Lelong (2472‑TW) and Ding‑Ying Investment (3715‑TW) are also worth exploring for growth opportunities from upgraded server component specifications.
