items.title: 關稅恐跳至25%！美點名韓光州-全羅半導體聚落　三星、海力士擴產踩雷
items.title_en: Tariffs Could Rise to 25%! US Flags Gwangju‑Jeolla Semiconductor Cluster, Samsung and SK Hynix Expansion Hits a Snag
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，美國貿易代表辦公室(USTR)日前在一份194頁報告中特別點名南韓光州-全羅半導體聚落，釋放出對韓實施15%產能過剩關稅的信號，並警告根據談判結果稅率可能升至最高25%。
《首爾經濟日報》報導，南韓半導體業界人士認為，美方此舉是為要求三星電子(005930KS) 和SK海力士(000660KS)在美建設前端晶圓廠，進而加大SK海力士紐約州NAND工廠談判，以及三星德州泰勒DRAM投資負擔的可能性。
光州-全羅半導體聚落是南韓總統李在明推動的「三大超級項目」核心之一，打算在光州軍民兩用機場原址建設一個以三星和SK海力士四座半導體工廠為軸心的大型產業聚落，目標是在2030年前投入營運，將其打造為「韓國版矽谷」的基石。
今年10月9日，SK集團董事長崔泰源表示，正打算盡快在光州建設一個新的半導體產業聚落，押注於強勁成長的需求，但未透露具體開工時間。
崔泰源還說，龍仁半導體園區的建設進度從原定的2045年提前至2033年，屆時預計該集群將有四座工廠建成。龍仁半導體園區是SK海力士規模最大的生產基地。
今年6月，南韓政府在青瓦台舉行「三大超級項目」國民報告會，宣布由三星跟SK海力士在光州一帶共同投資約800兆韓元、建設4座最尖端晶圓廠，兩家公司各承擔一半、分別建設兩座工廠。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that the U.S. Trade Representative’s Office (USTR) recently singled out South Korea’s Gwangju‑Jeolla semiconductor cluster in a 194‑page report, signaling a possible 15% anti‑oversupply tariff on Korean chips and warning that, depending on negotiations, the rate could climb to as high as 25%.

The Seoul Economic Daily says industry insiders believe the move is intended to pressure Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) and SK Hynix (000660.KS) to build front‑end wafer fabs in the United States, thereby strengthening SK Hynix’s negotiations for a NAND plant in New York and increasing the financial burden of Samsung’s Texas‑based DRAM investment.

The Gwangju‑Jeolla semiconductor cluster is one of the three “super projects” championed by President Lee Jae‑myung, planned as a large industrial hub centered on four semiconductor factories from Samsung and SK Hynix on the former site of the Gwangju dual‑use military‑civilian airport, with operations slated to begin before 2030 and envisioned as the foundation of a “Korean Silicon Valley.”

On October 9 of this year, SK Group chairman Choi Tae‑won said the company is preparing to quickly build a new semiconductor industrial park in Gwangju, betting on strong demand growth, though he did not disclose a specific groundbreaking date.

Choi added that the construction schedule for the Yong‑in Semiconductor Park has been moved up from the originally planned 2045 completion to 2033, at which point the cluster is expected to have four factories operational. Yong‑in is SK Hynix’s largest production site.

In June, the South Korean government held a national briefing on the three super projects at the Blue House, announcing that Samsung and SK Hynix will jointly invest about 800 trillion won to build four cutting‑edge wafer fabs in the Gwangju area, with each company bearing half the cost and constructing two plants each.

items.title: 3.4%→4.3%！川普怒轟GDP數據「蓄意誤導」：為何期中大選前不早說？必須徹查
items.title_en: 3.4%→4.3%! Trump Slams GDP Data as ‘Deliberate Deception’: Why Not Reveal It Before the Midterms? A Full Investigation Needed
paras: 美國總統川普週四(26日)在Truth Social上發文要求對美國商務部經濟分析局(BEA)最新GDP數據修正展開調查，並無端影射選前經濟統計遭「蓄意操弄」，意圖為共和黨在期中選舉慘敗找藉口。
BEA前一日公布經濟成長修正數據顯示，美國今年第三季GDP年化成長率由初值3.4%大幅上修至4.3%，創三年最快紀錄，上修主因在投資加速與政府支出回升，出口下滑則部分抵銷增幅。
對此川普猛批：「為何不在大選前公布正確數據？這不是小錯，是巨大且蓄意的錯誤，要求立即調查。」
川普還在另一篇感恩節長文諷刺統計機構「遲了三週才更正」，將矛頭指向政敵，但未提出任何人為操縱證據。
事實上，GDP初值本就依部分調查與估算發布，後續依完整數據修正是常態，此次0.9個百分點修正約為歷史平均的兩倍，但遠非「創紀錄」。
分析指出，共和黨失利主因在美伊戰爭與關稅政策推升通膨，選民體感疲弱，《美聯社》民調顯示76%選民認為經濟不佳，如今亮眼GDP反成政治火藥，官方數據公信力再受考驗。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump posted on Truth Social on Thursday (the 26th) demanding an investigation into the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) for revising the latest GDP figures, insinuating that pre‑election economic statistics were “deliberately manipulated” to give the Republican Party an excuse for its crushing loss in the midterm elections.

The BEA released revised growth data the day before, showing that the annualized GDP growth rate for the third quarter was sharply upgraded from an initial 3.4% to 4.3%, the fastest pace in three years. The upward revision was driven mainly by faster investment and a rebound in government spending, while a decline in exports partially offset the gain.
Trump blasted the revision, asking, “Why wasn’t the correct data released before the election? This isn’t a small mistake—it’s a huge, deliberate error. An immediate investigation is required.”

In another lengthy Thanksgiving‑time post, Trump mocked the statistical agency for “taking three weeks to correct” the numbers, directing blame at political opponents but offering no evidence of any human tampering.

In fact, the initial GDP estimate is always based on partial surveys and estimates, and it is routine for the figure to be revised once complete data are available. The 0.9‑percentage‑point upward adjustment is about twice the historical average, but it is far from a “record‑breaking” change.

Analysts say the Republican defeat stems mainly from the Iraq war and tariff policies that have stoked inflation, leaving voters feeling the economy is weak. An Associated Press poll shows 76% of voters think the economy is poor, and the surprisingly strong GDP reading now becomes political tinder, further testing the credibility of official data.

items.title: 美管制從晶片伸向「雲端後門」！ 輝達暫停向新加坡、馬來西亞、泰國與印尼供應AI伺服器
items.title_en: U.S. Export Controls Extend from Chips to "Cloud Backdoors"; Nvidia Halts AI Server Shipments to Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia
paras: 美國出口管制之網正從「晶片實體」緊縮到「海外算力最終使用者」，外媒最新報導指出，輝達(NVDA-US) 已通知戴爾、美超微等AI伺服器廠商，暫停向馬來西亞、新加坡、泰國、印尼發運搭載其AI晶片的伺服器，相關訂單目前無法交貨，恢復時點未定。輝達與夥伴正重新梳理合規流程，以對接華府新規。
《金融時報》報導，美國商務部已在上周一(16日)發布臨時最終規則，向新馬泰印及巴西出口、再出口先進計算晶片須獲許可，同時新增「遠程算力」條款，海外資料中心若向中國等受限制實體提供超過1200萬TPP(約750顆H100/H200)的聚合算力，同樣觸發許可，存量客戶有90天過渡期補件。
美方此舉等於堵死「晶片不進中國、但中企租海外機房調用」的曲線路徑，雲端服務商須做股權穿透、終端用途盡調，紅旗原則下「說不清客戶是誰」即推定知情。
東南亞是輝達高成長市場，去年新加坡子公司帳面營收1040億美元、年增72%(含部分台灣業務，非純本地銷售)，如今供應鏈急凍，衝擊直接傳導以下三大領域：
供應端：合作廠商停接新單，擔心高價GPU板卡變庫存
項目端：接近完工機房因晶片不到貨、客戶合規未明，投產將延期
融資端：星展、華僑、大華等東南亞銀行要求相關客戶補披露，貸款審批放緩。
對此，惠譽周四(26日)警告，亞太資料中心投資將降速，專租AI算力的新興雲廠(Neocloud)壓力最大，高利用率才能涵蓋GPU租金，晶片斷供即現金流失血。
短期來看，馬來西亞、泰國依賴中國客戶的項目受創最重，新加坡需自證「可信樞紐」地位；部分伺服器廠已把拓展重心轉向日韓等未列名市場，中國則加速佈局超微MI系列與國產替代，但萬卡集群互聯與軟件生態仍需時間。
paras_en: U.S. export controls are shifting from "physical chips" to "overseas compute end users," and foreign media reports that Nvidia (NVDA-US) has told Dell, Supermicro and other AI server makers to pause shipments of servers equipped with its AI chips to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia. The related orders cannot be delivered at present, and the resumption date is uncertain. Nvidia and its partners are re‑examining compliance procedures to align with the new Washington rules.

The Financial Times reported that the U.S. Department of Commerce issued a temporary final rule last Monday (the 16th) requiring licenses for exporting or re‑exporting advanced computing chips to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil, and added a "remote compute" provision. Overseas data centers that provide more than 12 million TPP (about 750 H100/H200 units) of aggregated compute to restricted entities in China and elsewhere will also trigger licensing, with existing customers given a 90‑day transition period to submit additional paperwork.

The move effectively blocks the workaround of "chips not entering China, but Chinese firms renting overseas data centers," forcing cloud providers to conduct equity‑level due diligence and end‑use verification. Under a red‑flag principle, any inability to identify the ultimate customer is presumed to be willful ignorance.

Southeast Asia is a high‑growth market for Nvidia; last year its Singapore subsidiary reported $104 billion in revenue, up 72% year‑on‑year (including some Taiwan business and not purely local sales). The sudden supply‑chain freeze now directly impacts three major areas:
Supply side: partner manufacturers are halting new orders, fearing that high‑priced GPU boards will become excess inventory.
Project side: data centers near completion are delayed because chips are unavailable and customer compliance status is unclear, pushing back production start‑ups.
Financing side: banks such as DBS, OCBC and UOB in Southeast Asia are demanding additional disclosures from affected customers, slowing loan approvals.

Fitch warned on Thursday (the 26th) that investment in Asia‑Pacific data centers will decelerate, with emerging AI‑only cloud operators like Neocloud facing the greatest pressure; only high utilization can cover GPU rental costs, and a chip supply cut would immediately bleed cash flow.

In the short term, projects in Malaysia and Thailand that depend on Chinese customers are hit hardest, while Singapore must prove its "trusted hub" status. Some server makers are shifting focus to untapped markets such as Japan and South Korea, and China is accelerating deployment of AMD’s MI series and domestic alternatives, though large‑scale GPU cluster interconnects and software ecosystems will still take time.

items.title: 川普再談推動黃仁勳復職：他沒有問題　我為全世界做了一件大好事
items.title_en: Trump Talks Again About Pushing Jensen Huang’s Return: He Has No Issues, I Did a Great Thing for the Whole World
paras: 美國總統川普週四(26日)在海湖莊園對記者表示，自黃仁勳復職輝達(NVDA-US)執行長後，還沒找他聊過天，但會找時間溝通。他把自己推動復職一事定調為「為美國、甚至全世界做了一件大好事」，並轉述黃仁勳把這次回歸稱作「第二個任期」，「很高興回來」，且「第二任期會比第一任期做得更好」。
面對「司法部尚未展開適當調查，怎麼確定黃仁勳不構成安全威脅」的追問，川普答道：「根據我掌握的資訊，黃仁勳沒問題」
當記者再問「有什麼具體資訊」，川普則回答：「我掌握的資訊有很多。」
上述對話把近期爭議攤開：白宮高層意見直接介入輝達董事會決策，但「資訊基礎」始終語焉不詳。黃仁勳復職本質是華府與矽谷的一次罕見合謀。
此前，川普承認與副總統范斯曾直接或間接聯繫輝達董事會，並在司法層面確認黃仁勳「無違法證據、無國安風險」後，才敢為復職背書。
但政治護航不代表爭議落幕。黃仁勳12月3日仍將赴國會出席出口管制聽證，民主黨議員質疑白宮「用國安保人」；輝達內部調查與司法部程序也還在跑。
對華爾街而言，這段海湖莊園對話釋出兩個信號：白宮短期內不會放任輝達崩盤，黃仁勳的個人權威已被重新鍍金；但「創辦人模式」凌駕治理常規的代價，會在下次波動來襲時再被重新計價。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump told reporters at Mar-a-Lago on Thursday (the 26th) that since Jensen Huang was reinstated as CEO of Nvidia (NVDA-US) he hasn’t spoken with him yet, but will find time to communicate. He framed his push for Huang’s return as “a great thing for the United States, even for the whole world,” and quoted Huang describing the comeback as a “second term,” saying he’s “very happy to be back” and that “the second term will be better than the first.”

When pressed about “how can we be sure Huang isn’t a security threat when the Justice Department hasn’t launched a proper investigation,” Trump replied, “Based on the information I have, Huang is fine.”
When the reporter asked for “what specific information,” Trump answered, “I have a lot of information.”

The exchange lays out the recent controversy: senior White House officials directly intervened in Nvidia’s board decisions, yet the “information basis” remains vague. Huang’s reinstatement is essentially a rare collusion between Washington and Silicon Valley.

Earlier, Trump admitted that he and Vice President Fans had directly or indirectly contacted Nvidia’s board, and only after the Justice Department confirmed that there was “no illegal evidence, no national‑security risk” regarding Huang did he feel comfortable endorsing the return.

But political backing does not end the dispute. Huang is still scheduled to appear before Congress on Dec. 3 for an export‑control hearing, where Democratic lawmakers have questioned the White House’s “national‑security guarantee”; Nvidia’s internal investigation and Justice Department proceedings are also still ongoing.

For Wall Street, the Mar‑a‑Lago remarks send two signals: the White House will not stand by and let Nvidia collapse in the short term, and Huang’s personal authority has been re‑gold‑plated; however, the cost of a “founder‑led model” overriding normal governance will be re‑priced when the next market shock hits.

items.title: 黃仁勳還無可取代？耶魯學者：輝達面臨的考題已經變了
items.title_en: Is Jensen Huang Still Irreplaceable? Yale Scholar Says Nvidia's Challenges Have Changed
paras: 黃仁勳重掌輝達(NVDA-US)，讓他是否「無可取代」成為市場焦點。《彭博》專欄作者Gautam Mukunda認為，黃仁勳過去33年的貢獻確實難以取代，但當輝達面臨的核心挑戰轉向出口管制、法遵與公司治理，答案可能已經改變。
Mukunda在耶魯大學管理學院教授領導力課程，也是《Indispensable: When Leaders Really Matter》一書作者。他指出，領導者的影響力與成功，取決於所處情境；曾讓企業成功的特質，在另一種環境下，也可能成為問題。

押注CUDA的膽識 曾替輝達開創新市場

Mukunda將黃仁勳歸類為「未經組織層層篩選的領導者」。一般大型企業執行長，多半歷經多年考核與升遷，創辦人則可能直接登上最高決策位置，未經同樣的篩選過程。
依他的研究，這類領導者的表現往往更偏離平均，可能極度成功，也可能大幅失敗，甚至在同一段職涯中出現兩種結果。
黃仁勳過去的成績，顯然落在成功的一端。《哈佛商業評論》曾在2017年至2019年，將他列為全球績效最佳執行長之一，而AI熱潮更凸顯他提前布局的眼光。
2006年，黃仁勳堅持推動CUDA，讓開發者能將繪圖處理器(GPU)用於各式運算。參與開發的輝達主管Ian Buck曾表示，這項投入耗資數十億美元，10年沒有賺錢，公司仍未放棄。
2012年，多倫多大學研究人員使用市售輝達晶片訓練神經網路，在影像辨識競賽中大幅領先，也讓AI發展找到重要的硬體基礎。
Mukunda認為，當企業正在建立尚不存在的市場，願意押注革命性創新的創辦人，正好符合當時需求；但企業面臨的問題改變，所需的領導方式也可能不同。

出口管制爭議升高 法遵成為關鍵考驗

Mukunda指出，黃仁勳回任，不會讓輝達面臨的檢視就此結束。他在文中提到，公司正受到先進晶片是否違規流入中國、是否誤導投資人等調查與質疑，黃仁勳也預定赴國會作證。
他並提及，兩黨議員希望透過下個月的國防法案，禁止輝達Blackwell晶片對中國銷售18個月。
在Mukunda看來，輝達接下來必須更加重視法遵，而黃仁勳高度聚焦成長的作風，未必最適合這項任務。
他指出，黃仁勳過去打造的管理架構，約有60人直接向他報告，董事會當時也未設董事長。Mukunda認為，這讓黃仁勳擁有高度控制權，也缺乏足以對他說「不」的人。
作者以克瑞斯(Colette Kress)代理執行長期間的決定為例：她在上任第一周表示，輝達已停止向中國出貨H200晶片，即使美國許可仍允許相關銷售。
Mukunda認為，不論克瑞斯的考量為何，這種審慎態度，可能正是輝達未來幾年所需。

仍需要下一個CUDA 董事會面臨領導難題

黃仁勳與川普的密切關係，也面臨不同的政治環境。Mukunda指出，這層關係去年曾協助輝達取得H20晶片對中銷售許可，但如今共和黨已展開調查，民主黨又將於明年1月掌控國會，反而可能成為政治攻防焦點。
然而，Mukunda也承認，輝達仍需要黃仁勳曾展現的創新膽識。隨著最大客戶開始設計自有晶片，公司可能需要另一個CUDA等級的突破。
這正是他眼中的兩難：催生重大創新的冒險精神，與公司當前必須更加審慎的要求，同時存在於同一位領導者身上。
Mukunda認為，股市重挫與川普施壓，壓縮了輝達董事會的選擇空間。川普稱「有些人無法取代」，但在作者看來，這是在評價黃仁勳過去的成就，尚未回答輝達未來究竟需要哪一種領導者。
他認為，評估領導者的關鍵，在於人與情境是否契合；過去的成功，無法直接證明未來仍不可取代。
paras_en: Jensen Huang's return to the helm of Nvidia (NVDA-US) has made the question of whether he is "irreplaceable" a market focus. Bloomberg columnist Gautam Mukunda argues that while Huang's 33‑year contributions have indeed been hard to replace, the core challenges Nvidia now faces have shifted to export controls, compliance and corporate governance, and the answer may have changed.

Mukunda, who teaches a leadership course at Yale School of Management and authored "Indispensable: When Leaders Really Matter," points out that a leader's influence and success depend on the context; traits that drove success in one environment can become problems in another.

Boldly betting on CUDA created new markets for Nvidia. Mukunda classifies Huang as a "leader who bypassed the usual organizational vetting." In large firms CEOs usually rise after years of assessment, while founders may step directly into top decision‑making without the same screening process.
His research shows that such leaders tend to deviate more from the average—some become extremely successful, others fail dramatically, and both outcomes can occur within the same career.

Huang's track record clearly falls on the successful side. Harvard Business Review listed him among the world’s top‑performing CEOs from 2017 to 2019, and the AI boom further highlighted his foresight in early positioning.

In 2006 Huang pushed for CUDA, enabling developers to use GPUs for general‑purpose computing. Nvidia executive Ian Buck recalled that the effort cost billions of dollars and took a decade to turn a profit, yet the company never gave up.

In 2012 University of Toronto researchers used off‑the‑shelf Nvidia chips to train neural networks, achieving a huge lead in an image‑recognition contest and providing a critical hardware foundation for AI development.

Mukunda believes that when a company is building a market that does not yet exist, a founder willing to bet on revolutionary innovation fits the need; but when the problems change, the required leadership style may also change.

Export‑control controversies rise, compliance becomes a key test. Mukunda notes that Huang’s return will not end the scrutiny Nvidia faces. The company is under investigation for possible illegal chip shipments to China and alleged investor mis‑leadings, and Huang is slated to testify before Congress.
He also mentions that bipartisan lawmakers aim to use next month’s defense bill to ban sales of Nvidia’s Blackwell chips to China for 18 months.
In Mukunda’s view, Nvidia must now place greater emphasis on compliance, and Huang’s growth‑focused style may not be the best fit for that task.
He points out that Huang built a management structure with about 60 direct reports and a board that at the time had no chair, giving him high control but few people able to say "no" to him.

The author cites decisions made by interim CEO Colette Kress: in her first week she announced that Nvidia had stopped shipping H200 chips to China, even though U.S. permission still allowed such sales.
Mukunda argues that regardless of Kress’s motives, this cautious approach may be exactly what Nvidia needs in the coming years.

The next CUDA‑level breakthrough presents a board leadership dilemma. Huang’s close ties with Donald Trump also face a different political climate. Mukunda notes that the relationship helped secure a permit for H20 chip sales to China last year, but now Republicans are investigating and Democrats will control Congress in January, turning the issue into a political battleground.

Nevertheless, Mukunda concedes that Nvidia still needs the innovative daring Huang demonstrated. As its biggest customers begin designing their own chips, the company may require another breakthrough on the scale of CUDA.
That is the dilemma he sees: the adventurous spirit that drives major innovation coexists with the current need for greater caution, both residing in the same leader.

Mukunda believes the market plunge and Trump’s pressure have narrowed the board’s options. Trump said "some people are irreplaceable," but the author sees that as an appraisal of Huang’s past achievements, not an answer to what kind of leader Nvidia will need in the future.
He concludes that evaluating a leader hinges on the fit between the person and the situation; past success does not automatically prove future irreplaceability.

items.title: 別指望聯準會出手救市？Fed傳聲筒：AI股暴跌拉高升息門檻 華許陷政策兩難
paras: 隨著科技股跌勢擴大，聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)正面臨兩難：究竟應該繼續升息、履行打擊通膨的強硬承諾，還是相信他長期重視的市場訊號，認為股市下跌及金融環境緊縮，已能替Fed達到部分抑制通膨的效果？
Fed傳聲筒、《華爾街日報》(WSJ)記者Nick Timiraos撰文指出，AI引發市場崩跌之後，Fed(Fed)升息的門檻已大幅提高。

2018年情景似曾相似 但通膨情勢已不同

Timiraos表示，華許也曾以批評者身分面對與現今類似的情況：2018年12月，美股從高點下跌約11%時，華許與億萬投資人朱肯米勒(Stanley Druckenmiller)曾在WSJ撰文，主張Fed應暫時停止緊縮政策。
然而，Fed當時仍決定升息。由於投資人不滿官員暗示可能進一步升息，股市賣壓加劇，美股創下1931年以來最差的12月表現。幾天後，Fed官員便釋出訊號，表示短期內沒有急於再次升息的打算。
目前的情勢讓人似曾相似：都是新任第一年的Fed主席在股市下跌、美元走強之際升息。決策官員也都面臨地緣政治衝擊，而選民剛在期中選舉中對總統川普投下反對票，川普當時也要求Fed不要緊縮貨幣政策。
但兩個時期最大的差異在於通膨。2018年，經過多年低於目標的情況後，通膨才剛升至Fed 2%的目標水準。但現在，美國通膨已連續超過五年高於目標。華許也曾表示，Fed不會接受通膨持續略高於目標的情況，這使Fed更難像2019年初那樣，以停止升息作為政策回應。

AI需求推升通膨 Fed官員對升息更趨強硬

目前Fed官員的注意力完全集中在通膨。根據美國商務部周三(25日)公布的數據，10月通膨進一步升溫。排除波動較大的食品及能源價格後，一項關鍵通膨指標年增率升至3.3%，高於9月的3.1%。該指標在2025年3月一度低至2.6%，之後川普政府大幅提高進口商品關稅。
展望未來，Fed官員愈來愈擔心，AI正在推升需求，與油價上漲或關稅不同，這類需求成長所帶來的價格壓力，可能不容易自行消退。
有一部分過去不認為企業漲價意願提高構成問題的官員，如今也開始認為這項疑慮確實存在。Fed下個月公布的經濟預測，可能顯示未來還需要進一步升息。
Fed第三把交椅、紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)周一告訴記者：「我最關注的不是過去的供給衝擊，而是需求究竟有多強勁，其中很大一部分與AI有關。」
這代表Fed官員對股市賣壓的擔憂，可能不像許多投資人想像的那麼強烈。股價下跌等金融情勢緊縮，正是升息減緩支出、壓低通膨的主要管道之一。
2007年至2021年擔任波士頓聯準銀行總裁的羅森格倫(Eric Rosengren)說：「你可以說，這正是Fed原本想達到的效果。如果想讓經濟降溫，就必須讓AI投資降溫。」
市場波動對Fed而言仍是挑戰，因為官員不希望讓投資人養成一種預期，認為每當股市下跌，央行就會出手緩衝損失。華爾街將這種現象稱為「Fed賣權」(Fed put)。

股市下跌能否替Fed降溫？關鍵在持續時間

讓政策抉擇更加複雜的是，Fed很難即時判斷何時能依賴市場替自己完成緊縮工作，因為金融情勢收緊可能來得極快，而且瞬間反轉。
輝達(NVDA-US)重新任命黃仁勳為執行長後，科技股周一大幅反彈，但由於市場憂心出口管制可能進一步收緊，以及複雜的AI融資安排引發不安，股市隨後再度下跌。
美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)上周將股市賣壓部分歸咎於Fed官員釋出可能進一步升息的訊號。他周日在CBS受訪時表示：「許多人認為，如果Fed過度緊縮，可能會犯下政策錯誤。」他也提到，投資人擔心民主黨在期中選舉取得進展後，可能放慢AI基礎設施建設。
Fed則有一部分官員認為，有序降溫反而有益於經濟。目前資料中心開發商採購晶片及電力設備的速度，甚至快於供應商交貨能力，使供應商擁有相當大的定價能力。芝加哥聯準銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)上周表示，企業界人士告訴他，各種電力相關產品的價格都在「飆升」。
Timiraos表示，股市若持續下跌，影響就更值得關注，因為這更可能改變家庭支出及企業融資決策。家庭若感覺財富縮水，通常會減少消費。而仰賴投資人熱情為新專案籌資的企業，也會發現募資難度提高。
這將使需求降溫，Fed官員屆時可能認為，無須升息到原先預期的幅度。
但如果股市賣壓演變成失序崩跌，Fed就會更加憂心，因為這可能讓負債沉重的企業蒙受損失，並引發信貸緊縮，形成自我強化的惡性循環。
威廉斯表示，如果金融情勢出現「重大」且「持續」的變化，將影響他的經濟展望。不過，他形容上周的市場波動「可能只是波動加劇，而非市場從根本上重新評估AI的前景」。

Fed12月升息幾成定局 後續政策分歧擴大

Fed9月已升息，儘管近期市場波動加劇，投資人仍普遍預期，Fed在12月8日至9日會議上將再次升息。之後的政策辯論，則集中在升息速度及最終升息幅度。
部分官員可能願意在再升息一次後暫停，前提是近期油價及其他商品價格下跌趨勢持續，且通膨降溫。過去兩個月，商品及能源價格已經下滑；近期隨著煉油商利潤率收窄，柴油及航空燃油等原油產品價格也進一步回落。
此外，借貸成本提高，加上外界反對興建新資料中心的政治阻力，也可能使部分AI基礎設施建設放緩。
但另一些官員認為，目前利率仍然太低。聖路易聯準銀行總裁穆薩列姆(Alberto Musalem)提出的計算顯示，明年可能有必要再升息3次。
威廉斯則表示，如果經濟持續成長超過產能負荷，通膨數據也持續高於預期，他不排除連續幾次會議都升息。他說：「你不會只是坐在那裡等待。」
Timiraos表示，從華許過去的發言，還難以判斷他會給近期市場波動多大影響。他長期主張，Fed過度依賴落後的政府經濟數據，應更加重視市場價格，才能避免措手不及，最後被迫出手救市。
例如，華許曾在2016年的一場演說中批評，Fed「系統性地低估即時市場價格訊號的重要性，通常隨後又以遲來且慌亂的政策回應，印證市場對央行賣權的預期」。
2018年10月，華許接受電子報出版商Jim Grant的Podcast訪問時表示，當時經濟「蓬勃發展」，Fed不應對市場波動反應過度。他說：「我希望大家關注的是實體經濟，而不是擔心股市下跌10%，或公債殖利率上升50或75個基點會發生什麼事。這不應該是他們關注的重點。」
然而，10周後，隨著股市賣壓讓風險較高的企業更難借款，華許便開始呼籲Fed暫停升息。
曾任Fed資深顧問的Jon Faust表示，如果市場跌勢進一步加劇，華許如何權衡市場動盪與通膨居高不下的證據，將成為「最核心的問題」。
Timiraos還指出，Fed官員通常比起股市，更密切關注信貸市場。Fed負責監管事務的副主席鮑曼(Michelle Bowman)本月表示，今年AI相關債務規模預計將超過8,000億美元，而與AI基礎設施建設相關的表外承諾，估計規模更超過這個數字的三倍。
前Fed官員羅森格倫表示：「如果開始看到許多負債沉重的企業面臨真正的財務困境，經濟就不只是放緩，而是可能出現非常顯著的衰退機制。」

items.title: AI吸乾全球記憶體產能 缺貨至少到2028年！馬斯克搶貨也碰壁 晶片貴如「金條」引竊賊覬覦
items.title_en: AI Drains Global Memory Chip Capacity, Shortages Expected Until 2028! Musk’s Attempts to Secure Chips Hit Roadblocks, Chips as Expensive as Gold Bars Attract Thieves
paras: AI資料中心火速擴張，引發全球記憶體晶片短缺，全球企業陷入搶貨大戰，成立採購戰情室、轉向灰色市場，甚至甘願支付數十倍價格。缺貨也推升電子產品售價、壓縮業者利潤，並衍生假貨、訂單遭轉賣及晶片竊案。預料供應緊張至少將持續到2028年新廠陸續投產，SK海力士更表示，供不應求將延續到2030年。
《華爾街日報》(WSJ)報導，這波缺貨潮已使部分記憶體晶片價格在過去一年飆升至原本的10倍，整個電子產業跟進漲價。美國民眾在今年年底購物季採購禮物將更加昂貴，例如蘋果(AAPL-US)已把MacBook筆電價格調漲100至500美元，漲幅視機型而定，而今年iPhone 18 Pro和Pro Max起售價也都較去年提高100美元。執行長庫克先前形容，這波晶片短缺就像「百年一遇的大洪水」。
此外，同一款微軟(MSFT-US)Xbox現在售價600美元，比一年前貴33%，亞馬遜(AMZN-US)Echo Dot智慧音箱則漲價60%，來到80美元。Meta(META-US)也將Quest 3虛擬實境頭戴裝置價格調漲50美元，達到350美元。

供給吃緊至少到2028年 新廠產能陸續開出

記憶體晶片一向帶有明顯的景氣循環特質，常經歷供給過剩後又陷入短缺。但現在的市場持續處於供不應求狀態，全球三大記憶體製造商南韓三星電子、SK海力士(SKHY-US)及美國的美光(MU-US)，都來不及快速擴充產能。
這波短缺預料至少會持續到2028年新工廠投入營運，儘管市場已傳出資料中心建設可能放緩的聲音。科技市場分析公司Counterpoint Research預估，全球產業DRAM產能將從今年到2028年增加50%。而DRAM是目前供應限制最嚴重的主要記憶體類型。
SK海力士的DRAM及專為AI運算設計的新一代高頻寬記憶體(HBM)晶片，產能已售罄至2029年。美光則已透過多年合約，預售至少1,500億美元的供應量。
SK海力士財務長Kim Woo-hyun上個月在財報電話會議中說：「供應無法跟上需求的情況，預料還會持續一段時間，這項限制可能延續至2030年。」

「這太瘋狂了！」全球買家赴韓搶貨

過去的長期供貨協議通常都是客戶與供應商之間的口頭承諾，但現在，雙方都開始尋求最長五年的具約束力合約，並要求客戶預付約25%至30%的採購成本，甚至分攤新工廠的投資成本。
晶片買家更是紛紛進駐韓國，希望爭取三星與SK海力士供貨。科技業高層表示，部分AI巨頭甚至安排員工住在三星晶片工廠附近的住宅區，每天前往確認進度，以確保交貨順利。
美國豪華車廠Karma Automotive執行長Marques McCammon這半年已四度飛往韓國，拜訪一家主要記憶體供應商，頻繁程度甚至讓他在首爾有了自己最喜歡的烤肉店。
McCammon表示，雖然對方願意洽談，然而一旦涉及敲定價格和交貨日期，就會開始閃爍其詞。他說：「出於禮貌，他們會撥出時間會面，但要真正做出決定非常困難。」
台灣隨身碟製造商宇瞻科技(Apacer)(8271-TW)則透過貸款預留資金，以便一旦有晶片供貨，就能立即搶購。該公司副董事長陳明達說：「只要晶片出現，我們就買。這太瘋狂了，但沒有其他辦法。」

就連SpaceX(SPCX-US)與特斯拉(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)也遭遇相同困境，根據Capital Group投資組合經理Carl Kawaja，馬斯克在6月一場研討會上透露，他曾向三星提出長期晶片採購承諾，但三星會長李在鎔回他，「其他所有人也都提出相同條件，你還能提供什麼？」接著，當馬斯克提出願為三星新晶片工廠提供融資擔保，李在鎔的回答仍是：「其他人也都提出這項條件，你還能拿出什麼？」

成立採購戰情室、轉向灰色市場

位於美國拉斯維加斯的供應鏈顧問公司Seraph，有一家客戶是美國先進駕駛輔助系統(ADAS)開發商，為了取得晶片，不得不轉向數百家獨立經紀商及灰色市場採購。
Seraph執行長Ambrose Conroy表示，該客戶為某項特定零組件支付的價格，最高達原先預算的40倍。這家客戶無法將增加的成本轉嫁給汽車製造商客戶，導致利潤率受到侵蝕，明年恐怕不得不漲價。
Seraph許多客戶企業已成立採購團隊，如今每周有六天待在臨時設置的戰情室。他們透過試算表整理資訊，主動致電數百家獨立經紀商，並大量寄送電子郵件，四處尋找零散庫存。
Conroy表示，有一家Seraph客戶曾找到一批由中國經紀商持有的韓國記憶體模組，但公司花了五天才完成內部程序，核准電匯付款。等到程序完成時，報價已經失效，經紀商開出的價格更暴漲50%。這家公司最終決定放棄交易。

記憶體身價暴漲 連倉庫也成竊賊目標

另一個困擾整個產業的新問題，是晶片竊案。
影視製作軟硬體開發商Blackmagic Design表示，去年底位於印尼的一座倉庫遭竊，失竊物品包括8TB快閃記憶體產品，價值約10萬美元。該公司懷疑這起竊案是由一名前員工策劃，在那之後增加全天候警衛人力，並擴大倉庫監控系統。
Petty說：「這不是我們原本預料會發生的事。它們已經不只是記憶體晶片，而是記憶體金條，因為一旦價格漲到某個程度，就成了可以交易的財富。」
paras_en: AI data centers are expanding rapidly, causing a global shortage of memory chips and sparking a battle for supplies among companies worldwide. They have set up procurement war rooms, turned to the grey market, and are even willing to pay dozens of times the price. The shortage has pushed up the prices of electronic products, squeezed company profits, and led to counterfeit goods, order resales, and chip theft cases. Supply tightness is expected to last at least until 2028 as new plants come online, and SK Hynix has said the demand‑supply gap will continue until 2030.

The Wall Street Journal reports that this shortage has pushed some memory chip prices up to ten times their original levels over the past year, and the entire electronics industry has followed suit with price increases. U.S. consumers will face higher costs during this year’s holiday shopping season; for example, Apple (AAPL‑US) has raised MacBook laptop prices by $100 to $500 depending on the model, and the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max launch prices are also $100 higher than last year. CEO Tim Cook previously described the chip shortage as a "once‑in‑a‑century flood."

In addition, the same Microsoft (MSFT‑US) Xbox now sells for $600, 33% more than a year ago, while Amazon (AMZN‑US) Echo Dot smart speakers have increased by 60% to $80. Meta (META‑US) has also raised the price of its Quest 3 VR headset by $50 to $350.

Supply is tight at least until 2028 as new plant capacity comes online. Memory chips have always shown clear cyclical characteristics, often experiencing oversupply followed by shortages. But the current market remains in a state of supply‑demand imbalance, and the world’s three major memory manufacturers—South Korea’s Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix (SKHY‑US), and U.S. Micron (MU‑US)—cannot quickly expand capacity.

This shortage is expected to last at least until 2028 when new factories become operational, even though there are reports that data‑center construction may slow down. Counterpoint Research, a technology market analysis firm, estimates that global DRAM capacity will increase by 50% from this year to 2028. DRAM is the type of memory most severely limited in supply.

SK Hynix’s DRAM and its new high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) chips designed for AI computing are sold out through 2029. Micron has pre‑sold at least $150 billion worth of supply through long‑term contracts.
SK Hynix CFO Kim Woo‑hyun said in a recent earnings call that the supply shortfall will continue for a while and that the restriction could last until 2030.

"This is insane!" Global buyers flock to Korea to secure chips. Long‑term supply agreements were previously verbal commitments between customers and suppliers, but now both sides are seeking binding contracts up to five years, requiring customers to prepay 25% to 30% of the purchase cost and even share new plant investment costs.

Chip buyers are moving into Korea to secure supplies from Samsung and SK Hynix. Tech executives say some AI giants even arrange for employees to live in residential areas near Samsung’s chip plants and visit daily to confirm progress and ensure smooth delivery.

Karma Automotive CEO Marques McCammon has flown to Korea four times in the past six months to visit a major memory supplier, and his frequent visits have even earned him a favorite barbecue restaurant in Seoul.

McCammon said that although the supplier is willing to negotiate, once price and delivery dates are involved, they start to waver. He said, "Out of politeness, they will set a meeting time, but making a real decision is very difficult."

Apacer (8271‑TW), a Taiwanese flash drive manufacturer, has reserved funds through loans so that it can immediately purchase chips when supply becomes available. Vice Chairman Chen Ming‑da said, "As soon as chips appear, we buy. It’s insane, but there’s no other way."

Even SpaceX (SPCX‑US) and Tesla (TSLA‑US) CEO Elon Musk has faced the same dilemma. According to Capital Group portfolio manager Carl Kawaja, Musk revealed at a June seminar that he had offered Samsung a long‑term chip purchase commitment, but Samsung Chairman Lee Jae‑yong replied, "Everyone else has made the same offer; what can you offer?" When Musk offered to provide financing guarantees for Samsung’s new chip plant, Lee’s answer was the same: "Everyone else has made this condition; what can you offer?"

A procurement war room was set up and the grey market was turned to. Seraph, a supply‑chain consulting firm in Las Vegas, has a client that is an American advanced driver‑assist system (ADAS) developer. To obtain chips, the client had to turn to hundreds of independent brokers and the grey market.

Seraph CEO Ambrose Conroy said the client paid up to 40 times the original budget for a specific component. The client could not pass the increased cost onto its automotive manufacturer customers, eroding profit margins and likely forcing a price increase next year.

Many of Seraph’s client companies have established procurement teams, and now they spend six days a week in a temporary war room. They use spreadsheets to organize information, proactively call hundreds of independent brokers, and send large volumes of emails to find scattered inventory.

Conroy said a Seraph client once found a batch of Korean memory modules held by a Chinese broker, but the company took five days to complete internal procedures and approve a wire transfer. By the time the process was finished, the quote had expired and the broker’s price had risen 50%. The company ultimately decided to abandon the deal.
The price of memory has skyrocketed, and warehouses have become targets for thieves. Another new problem troubling the entire industry is chip theft.

Blackmagic Design, a film and television production software and hardware developer, said that at the end of last year a warehouse in Indonesia was robbed, with stolen items including 8 TB flash memory products worth about $100,000. The company suspects the theft was planned by a former employee, and has since increased 24‑hour security personnel and expanded its warehouse monitoring system.
Petty said, "This is not something we expected to happen. They’re no longer just memory chips; they’re memory gold bars, because once the price rises to a certain level, they become tradable wealth."

items.title: 《巴隆》點名這5檔科技股避開AI風暴 蘋果抗跌、這兩檔飆逾30%
items.title_en: Barron's Names 5 Tech Stocks to Dodge the AI Storm: Apple Holds Up, Two Stocks Surge Over 30%
paras: 科技股近幾個月走勢顛簸，但仍有值得投資人持續關注的贏家，《巴隆周刊》(Barron’s)點名從10月初至今呈現上漲的五檔股票，包括蘋果和惠普。
回顧美股近期走勢，投資人信心在10月6日達到高峰，當時科技股為主的那斯達克綜合指數與輝達等個股同步創下收盤歷史新高，但之後市場走勢一路下滑。那斯達克綜合指數從那時至今下跌約16%。
大型科技公司從10月底開始陸續公布最新一季財報。儘管企業獲利持續成長，資本支出也同步增加，自由現金流卻也不斷萎縮。亞馬遜(AMZN-US)和Alphabet(GOOGL-US)過去一直是創造現金流的機器，但如今為建置AI運作所需基礎設施而投入的資金，正逐漸對財務造成壓力。
支持這波巨額支出的人士認為，這些投資有其必要性，因為AI需求絲毫沒有降溫跡象，從雲端營收加速成長可以得例。如果有更多產能投入運作，相關營收甚至可能進一步提高。
另一方面，空方則擔心，企業目前仍未從這些投資中取得足夠回報，無法證明長期投入的可持續性。儘管如此，AI軍備競賽仍迫使企業持續砸錢。
在這樣的環境下，蘋果(AAPL-US)顯得格外突出。蘋果在AI開發上的支出不及其他大型科技同業，選擇與Google和OpenAI等業者合作，而非完全自行開發相關技術。
華爾街原本對這項策略感到擔憂，但如今市場開始肯定蘋果的做法：讓其他業者競逐AI霸主地位，自己則從旁等待時機：蘋果自10月6日以來股價上漲4.4%，成為科技股中值得注意的避風港。
AI晶片、伺服器及其他硬體製造商原本受惠於龐大的AI支出，但美國期中選舉結果出爐，由把放緩資料中心興建列為主要政見之一的民主黨大獲全勝，加劇了市場原有的不安情緒，。

資金轉向高股息與低AI曝險科技股

Gabelli Funds投資組合經理Hendi Susanto表示，投資人目前正轉向股息收益穩定、AI曝險較低的科技股。
惠普(HP Inc.)(HPQ-US)周三收盤上漲11.6%。該公司股價自10月6日以來下跌1.8%，但本月迄今上漲7.1%，考量到11月科技股整體表現疲弱，這樣的漲幅相當突出。惠普擁有4%的股息殖利率。
硬體產業以外，Gen Digital(GEN-US)也是表現亮眼的個股。這家為消費者提供身分保護服務的資安公司，正從AI模型能力提升和資安漏洞頻傳的環境中，受益於網路攻擊防護服務的需求，該公司股價自10月6日以來上漲31%。
AppLovin(APP-US)股價同期上漲30%，這家行動廣告科技平台協助媒合廣告商與內容發布商，該公司最近公布亮眼財報，部分成長動能來自廣告商更頻繁使用其Axon AI模型，證明AI確實能夠提高營收變現能力。
另一檔值得關注的是電玩遊戲公司Take-Two Interactive Software(TTWO-US)。Take-Two上周推出《俠盜獵車手VI》(Grand Theft Auto VI)，可說是史上最受期待的遊戲上市之一。
該公司於11月20日宣布，GTA VI上市首日銷售額達38億美元，遠遠超出市場預期。Take-Two股價自10月6日以來上漲9.4%。
paras_en: Tech stocks have been volatile in recent months, but there are still winners worth investors' continued attention. Barron's highlighted five stocks that have risen since early October, including Apple and HP.

Looking back at recent U.S. market moves, investor confidence peaked on October 6 when the Nasdaq Composite, dominated by tech stocks, and individual names like Nvidia hit record closing highs, but the market has since slid. The Nasdaq Composite has fallen about 16% since then.

Large tech firms began reporting their latest quarterly results at the end of October. Although earnings continue to grow and capital spending rises, free cash flow is shrinking. Amazon (AMZN-US) and Alphabet (GOOGL-US) have long been cash‑flow machines, but the money they’re pouring into AI infrastructure is increasingly straining their finances.

Proponents of the massive spending argue the investments are necessary because AI demand shows no signs of cooling, as evidenced by accelerating cloud revenue growth. More capacity could even boost related revenues further.

On the other hand, bears worry that companies have not yet seen enough returns from these investments to prove the sustainability of long‑term spending. Nevertheless, the AI arms race continues to force firms to keep splashing cash.

In this environment, Apple (AAPL-US) stands out. Its AI development spend is lower than other big tech peers, opting to partner with Google, OpenAI and others rather than building everything in‑house.

Wall Street was initially uneasy about this strategy, but the market now rewards Apple’s approach: letting others fight for AI dominance while it waits on the sidelines. Apple’s stock has risen 4.4% since October 6, making it a notable safe haven among tech stocks.

AI chip, server and other hardware makers originally benefited from massive AI spending, but the U.S. midterm election results—where Democrats, who pledged to slow data‑center construction, won decisively—have heightened existing market anxiety.

Funds are shifting toward high‑dividend, low‑AI‑exposure tech stocks. Gabelli Funds portfolio manager Hendi Susanto says investors are now favoring stocks with stable dividend yields and lower AI risk.

HP Inc. (HPQ-US) closed Wednesday up 11.6%. The stock had fallen 1.8% since October 6 but is up 7.1% for the month, a standout gain given the overall weak tech performance in November. HP offers a 4% dividend yield.

Outside hardware, Gen Digital (GEN-US) is also shining. The consumer identity‑protection cybersecurity firm is benefiting from heightened demand for network‑attack defenses as AI model capabilities improve and breaches multiply, with its stock up 31% since October 6.

AppLovin (APP-US) shares have risen 30% over the same period. The mobile‑ad tech platform that matches advertisers with publishers recently posted strong earnings, driven in part by advertisers using its Axon AI model more frequently, proving AI can boost revenue monetization.
Another stock to watch is video‑game publisher Take‑Two Interactive Software (TTWO-US). Take‑Two launched Grand Theft Auto VI last week, one of the most anticipated game releases ever.
The company announced on November 20 that GTA VI generated $3.8 billion in sales on its first day, far exceeding market expectations. Take‑Two’s stock has risen 9.4% since October 6.

items.title: 關稅恐跳至25%！美點名韓光州-全羅半導體聚落　三星、海力士擴產踩雷
items.title_en: Tariffs Could Rise to 25%! US Flags Gwangju‑Jeolla Semiconductor Cluster, Samsung and SK Hynix Expansion Hits a Snag
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，美國貿易代表辦公室(USTR)日前在一份194頁報告中特別點名南韓光州-全羅半導體聚落，釋放出對韓實施15%產能過剩關稅的信號，並警告根據談判結果稅率可能升至最高25%。
《首爾經濟日報》報導，南韓半導體業界人士認為，美方此舉是為要求三星電子(005930KS) 和SK海力士(000660KS)在美建設前端晶圓廠，進而加大SK海力士紐約州NAND工廠談判，以及三星德州泰勒DRAM投資負擔的可能性。
光州-全羅半導體聚落是南韓總統李在明推動的「三大超級項目」核心之一，打算在光州軍民兩用機場原址建設一個以三星和SK海力士四座半導體工廠為軸心的大型產業聚落，目標是在2030年前投入營運，將其打造為「韓國版矽谷」的基石。
今年10月9日，SK集團董事長崔泰源表示，正打算盡快在光州建設一個新的半導體產業聚落，押注於強勁成長的需求，但未透露具體開工時間。
崔泰源還說，龍仁半導體園區的建設進度從原定的2045年提前至2033年，屆時預計該集群將有四座工廠建成。龍仁半導體園區是SK海力士規模最大的生產基地。
今年6月，南韓政府在青瓦台舉行「三大超級項目」國民報告會，宣布由三星跟SK海力士在光州一帶共同投資約800兆韓元、建設4座最尖端晶圓廠，兩家公司各承擔一半、分別建設兩座工廠。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that the U.S. Trade Representative’s Office (USTR) recently singled out South Korea’s Gwangju‑Jeolla semiconductor cluster in a 194‑page report, signaling a possible 15% anti‑oversupply tariff on Korean chips and warning that, depending on negotiations, the rate could climb to as high as 25%.

The Seoul Economic Daily says industry insiders believe the move is intended to pressure Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) and SK Hynix (000660.KS) to build front‑end wafer fabs in the United States, thereby strengthening SK Hynix’s negotiations for a NAND plant in New York and increasing the financial burden of Samsung’s Texas‑based DRAM investment.

The Gwangju‑Jeolla semiconductor cluster is one of the three “super projects” championed by President Lee Jae‑myung, planned as a large industrial hub centered on four semiconductor factories from Samsung and SK Hynix on the former site of the Gwangju dual‑use military‑civilian airport, with operations slated to begin before 2030 and envisioned as the foundation of a “Korean Silicon Valley.”

On October 9 of this year, SK Group chairman Choi Tae‑won said the company is preparing to quickly build a new semiconductor industrial park in Gwangju, betting on strong demand growth, though he did not disclose a specific groundbreaking date.

Choi added that the construction schedule for the Yong‑in Semiconductor Park has been moved up from the originally planned 2045 completion to 2033, at which point the cluster is expected to have four factories operational. Yong‑in is SK Hynix’s largest production site.

In June, the South Korean government held a national briefing on the three super projects at the Blue House, announcing that Samsung and SK Hynix will jointly invest about 800 trillion won to build four cutting‑edge wafer fabs in the Gwangju area, with each company bearing half the cost and constructing two plants each.

items.title: 軟銀5年內隱含違約機率升至34.8% AI回報疑慮燒進債市
items.title_en: SoftBank's 5-Year Implied Default Probability Rises to 34.8% as AI Return Concerns Spread to the Bond Market
paras: 軟銀五年期信用違約交換（CDS）利差週四(26日)升至534.6個基點，創2022年10月以來新高，市場報價隱含的五年內違約機率達34.8%。
軟銀集團重押人工智慧（AI），投資人愈來愈擔心，這些投資能否及時帶來足夠現金流，供集團償還債務。
軟銀被視為觀察AI投資前景的風向球，迄今已向OpenAI投入646億美元，最近一筆100億美元的資金來自9月發債。隨著軟銀舉債加碼OpenAI，債券投資人也愈來愈在意，AI業務究竟還要多久才能帶來收入。
這份疑慮在短短三週內明顯升高。11月6日，軟銀股價下跌10.8%，五年期CDS利差升至466個基點。
到了本週四，利差較當時再擴大近70個基點。當天軟銀股價在東京反彈7.3%，收復前一交易日14.83%的部分跌幅，違約保險成本卻連續第二天攀升。
大和證券資深策略師菅原正人表示，AI業務持續擴張的趨勢未變，但要將成長轉為實際收入，恐怕得花更長時間。對仰賴未來現金流償債的AI企業而言，收入來得愈晚，再融資也可能愈困難。
軟銀的美元債也反映出資金成本上升。集團9月發行創紀錄的111億美元高收益債，其中一檔美元債的票面利率達9.75%，是軟銀歷來發行美元債的最高票息。據彭博數據，該檔債券自發行以來，利差已擴大約四成，達到約644個基點。
標普全球早在3月就將軟銀的評等展望從「穩定」下調至「負向」，理由是追加投資OpenAI的300億美元可能削弱集團的流動性與信用品質。軟銀的長期發行人評等維持在非投資等級的BB+。
彭博產業研究認為，軟銀仍有時間透過出售資產，將調整後貸款價值比降至35%以下，以守住目前評等。
信用市場的壓力也延伸至AI基礎設施業者。10月中旬，甲骨文五年期CDS利差升至歷史新高288個基點，資料中心營運商CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 的CDS利差則突破1,000個基點。
美國期中選舉由民主黨大勝後，市場擔心AI基礎建設腳步放慢，舉債投入AI的企業也面臨CDS利差擴大的壓力。
paras_en: SoftBank's five‑year credit default swap (CDS) spread rose to 534.6 basis points on Thursday (the 26th), a peak not seen since October 2022, implying a five‑year default probability of 34.8% according to market pricing.

SoftBank Group has heavily bet on artificial intelligence (AI), and investors are increasingly worried whether these investments will generate enough cash flow in time for the group to service its debt.

SoftBank is seen as a bellwether for AI investment prospects; to date it has poured $64.6 billion into OpenAI, with the most recent $10 billion tranche coming from a September bond issuance. As SoftBank raises more debt to fund OpenAI, bond investors are paying closer attention to how long AI operations will take to produce revenue.
This concern has risen sharply over just three weeks. On November 6, SoftBank’s share price fell 10.8% and the five‑year CDS spread jumped to 466 basis points.

By Thursday of this week the spread had widened by another roughly 70 basis points. That day SoftBank’s stock rebounded 7.3% in Tokyo, recouping part of the 14.83% loss from the previous session, while the cost of default protection rose for the second consecutive day.

Masato Sugawara, a senior strategist at Daiwa Securities, said the trend of expanding AI operations remains unchanged, but turning that growth into actual revenue will likely take longer. For AI‑focused companies that rely on future cash flow to repay debt, delayed revenue makes refinancing increasingly difficult.

SoftBank’s dollar‑denominated bonds also reflect rising funding costs. In September the group issued a record‑high $11.1 billion high‑yield bond, with one tranche carrying a 9.75% coupon—the highest coupon SoftBank has ever issued on dollar debt. Bloomberg data show that since issuance the spread on that bond has widened by about 40%, reaching roughly 644 basis points.

S&P Global downgraded SoftBank’s rating outlook from “stable” to “negative” back in March, citing the $30 billion additional investment in OpenAI as a potential drain on the group’s liquidity and credit quality. SoftBank’s long‑term issuer rating remains at non‑investment‑grade BB+.
Bloomberg’s industry research believes SoftBank still has time to sell assets and bring its adjusted loan‑to‑value ratio below 35%, thereby preserving its current rating.

Credit‑market pressure is also spilling over to AI infrastructure providers. In mid‑October, Oracle’s five‑year CDS spread hit a historic high of 288 basis points, while data‑center operator CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) saw its CDS spread break the 1,000‑basis‑point mark.

After the U.S. midterm elections resulted in a strong Democratic victory, markets grew concerned that AI infrastructure spending could slow, putting additional pressure on CDS spreads for companies borrowing to fund AI initiatives.

items.title: 中韓記憶體廠拚技術！華為新HBM介面寬度達HBM4兩倍 長鑫秀新一代DDR5
items.title_en: China and South Korea Memory Makers Compete on Technology! Huawei's New HBM Interface Width Is Twice That of HBM4, ChangXin Showcases Next-Gen DDR5
paras: 華為、長鑫科技(688825-CN) 將在2027年國際固態電路會議（ISSCC）與三星電子(005930KS) 、SK海力士(000660KS) 同台較勁。
據南韓半導體媒體《The Elec》報導，華為將展示客製化高頻寬記憶體（HBM），資料介面寬度達4096位元，是HBM4標準的兩倍。長鑫則將發表32Gb DDR5晶片與新一代LPDDR6介面技術。
ISSCC 2027將於2月14日至18日在美國舊金山舉行。根據電機電子工程師學會（IEEE）公布的議程草案，華為深圳團隊預計於當地時間16日下午發表研究成果。
這款客製化HBM採用五層晶圓對晶圓（Wafer-on-Wafer）混合鍵合技術，整合64個記憶體通道與4096個資料接腳（DQ），並將負責DRAM讀寫的記憶體控制器納入HBM架構。
華為的設計之所以受到關注，在於更寬的介面能讓更多資料同時傳輸。HBM4標準的資料介面寬度為2048位元，華為將其加倍至4096位元，意味著即使單一接腳的傳輸速率較低，整體頻寬仍有機會與韓廠競爭。
以三星公布、單腳速率達17Gbps的HBM4E為例，有分析估算，若華為方案的單腳速率超過8.5Gbps，理論頻寬就有望超越三星這款產品。
除了加寬介面，華為也調整了記憶體控制器的位置。傳統HBM通常由多層DRAM晶片堆疊而成，透過底部的邏輯晶片與外部處理器交換資料。
華為將記憶體控制器直接整合進HBM，可望縮短控制邏輯與記憶體陣列之間的資料傳輸路徑，降低外部連接造成的延遲與耗電，也讓華為有更多空間，依特定AI處理器的需求設計記憶體架構。
在封裝方面，五層晶圓之間採用混合鍵合，可在有限面積內形成更密集的連接，縮短訊號傳輸路徑，也為堆疊更多層晶圓提供基礎。隨著AI處理器對記憶體頻寬與能源效率的要求提高，如何在堆疊晶片之間高效率傳輸資料，已成為HBM封裝技術的發展重點。
長鑫此次則聚焦兩項新一代DRAM研究。其中，容量為32Gb的DDR5晶片同樣採用混合鍵合技術，單腳傳輸速率達9.2Gbps。另一項成果為LPDDR6介面技術，傳輸速率達17.6Gbps。
本屆ISSCC共收到1029篇投稿，最終錄取274篇。中國、香港及澳門合計入選124篇，占45.3%，居各地區之首，美國與南韓分別有49篇及45篇入選。若單看此次中韓廠商同台競逐的記憶體領域，28篇入選論文中，南韓占12篇，中國占8篇。
paras_en: Huawei, ChangXin Technology (688825-CN) will compete on the same stage with Samsung Electronics (005930KS) and SK Hynix (000660KS) at the 2027 International Solid-State Circuits Conference (ISSCC).

According to South Korean semiconductor media The Elec, Huawei will showcase a custom high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) with a data interface width of 4096 bits, twice the HBM4 standard. ChangXin will present a 32‑Gb DDR5 chip and next‑generation LPDDR6 interface technology.

ISSCC 2027 will be held Feb 14‑18 in San Francisco, USA. According to the draft agenda released by the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE), Huawei’s Shenzhen team is scheduled to present its research on the afternoon of the 16th local time.

The custom HBM uses a five‑layer wafer‑on‑wafer hybrid bonding technique, integrating 64 memory channels and 4096 data pins (DQ), and incorporates the DRAM read/write controller into the HBM architecture.

Huawei’s design draws attention because the wider interface allows more data to be transferred simultaneously. The HBM4 standard’s data interface width is 2048 bits; Huawei doubles it to 4096 bits, meaning that even if the per‑pin transfer rate is lower, the overall bandwidth could still compete with Korean manufacturers.

Taking Samsung’s HBM4E, which advertises a per‑pin rate of 17 Gbps, analysts estimate that if Huawei’s solution achieves a per‑pin rate above 8.5 Gbps, its theoretical bandwidth could surpass Samsung’s product.

In addition to widening the interface, Huawei also relocated the memory controller. Traditional HBM typically consists of multiple stacked DRAM dies that exchange data with the external processor via a logic die at the bottom.

Huawei integrates the memory controller directly into the HBM, which could shorten the data path between control logic and the memory array, reduce latency and power consumption from external connections, and give Huawei more flexibility to design the memory architecture for specific AI processors.

In packaging, the hybrid bonding between the five wafer layers enables denser connections within a limited area, shortening signal paths and providing a basis for stacking more wafer layers. As AI processors demand higher memory bandwidth and energy efficiency, efficient data transfer between stacked chips has become a key focus of HBM packaging technology.

ChangXin’s focus this time is on two next‑generation DRAM research items. The 32‑Gb DDR5 chip also uses hybrid bonding and achieves a per‑pin transfer rate of 9.2 Gbps. The other result is an LPDDR6 interface technology with a transfer rate of 17.6 Gbps.

This ISSCC received 1,029 paper submissions, with 274 finally accepted. China, Hong Kong and Macau together had 124 papers selected (45.3%), the highest proportion, while the United States and South Korea had 49 and 45 papers respectively. Looking only at the memory papers where Chinese and Korean vendors compete, 28 papers were accepted, with South Korea accounting for 12 and China for 8.

items.title: 牛彈琴：這個建議一出 德國人吵翻了
items.title_en: Niu Danqin: This Suggestion Has Germans Up in Arms
paras: 世間最尷尬的場景，莫過於你昔日師傅當著你的面，把自己擺上貨架要給你。
反正，最近德國頂級經濟學家——基爾世界經濟研究所所長莫里茨·舒拉里克一個建議，震撼了整個德國和世界汽車界。
什麼建議？
舒拉里克的原話是：「趁著還能賣個好價錢，把沃爾夫斯堡的某家大型企業賣給中國人，也不失為一個好主意。」
某個大型企業是哪個？
赫赫有名的福斯汽車是也！
更具諷刺意味的是，發言現場，福斯汽車柏林代表處負責人邁克爾·揚森，就靜靜坐在聽眾席。
舒拉里克不是脫口秀演員。他執掌的基爾世界經濟研究所，被認為是德國歷史最悠久、最具影響力的經濟智庫。他說話時，也帶著一種精算師式平靜。
他的邏輯，也極其「經濟學」：在汽車製造領域，德國「現在已經是開發中國家了」，所以從德國角度出發，現在最關鍵的，不是福斯姓「德」還是姓「中」，而是「價值創造和生產活動能否留在德國」，至於生產設施歸誰所有，是「次要問題」。
具中國官方背景微信公眾號「牛彈琴」27日說，這話翻譯成大白話就是：廠子可以是你家的，但機器得在我家轉，工人得在我家領工資，至於老闆是誰，無所謂。
更有意思的是，他還補了一刀：歐洲應該允許中國電動車來賣，但要效仿當年中國合資車廠模式，用補貼規則倒逼中國車廠把生產線遷移至歐洲。
看來，德國人在努力向中國人學習啊！
「牛彈琴」說，當年手把手教中國的師傅，如今開始抄中國的作業——這大概就是時代最不動聲色的反轉。
現場一片譁然已經是很客氣的描述。真正炸鍋的，是德國汽車圈同行。
被譽為德國汽車經濟學「教皇」之一的費迪南德·杜登赫費爾，用一句德語俗語把舒拉里克懟了回去：這無異於「把貓頭鷹送往雅典」。
貓頭鷹在雅典遍地都是，用不著你千里迢迢送過去。
他的意思是，大眾的病根，早就寫在腦門上了，還用你一個經濟學家來「發現」？
杜登赫費爾越說越不客氣，乾脆把舒拉里克的方案翻譯成了清倉廣告：福斯、保時捷、奧迪、斯柯達、Cupra、MAN、斯堪尼亞，加上福斯商用車，「一攬子打包，賤賣給中國」，末了還補一句，「也許再搭幾家機械製造商」。
他用的那個德文詞「verhökern」，不是中性意義上的「出售」，而是帶著地攤甩貨味道的「賤賣」。
換做一句中國俗語：崽賣爺田不心疼。
另一位重量級人物、德國汽車管理中心主任斯特凡·布拉策爾的定性更短，也更重：把福斯賣給中國，是「工業政策上的投降」。
paras_en: The most awkward scene in the world is when your former master, right in front of you, puts himself on the shelf to be sold to you.
Anyway, a recent suggestion by Germany's top economist – Moritz Schularick, director of the Kiel Institute for the World Economy – has shaken the entire German and global automotive industry.
What is the suggestion?
Schularick’s exact words were: “While you can still get a good price, selling a large company in Wolfsburg to the Chinese is also a good idea.”
Which large company is it?
The world‑famous Volkswagen, of course!
Ironically, at the press conference, Michael Jansen, head of Volkswagen’s Berlin representative office, sat quietly in the audience.

Schularick is not a talk‑show host. He heads the Kiel Institute for the World Economy, regarded as Germany’s oldest and most influential economic think‑tank, and he speaks with the calm of an actuary.

His logic is extremely “economics‑driven”: in the automotive manufacturing sector, Germany is “already a developing country,” so from a German perspective the crucial issue now is not whether Volkswagen is “German” or “Chinese,” but whether “value creation and production activities can stay in Germany.” Who owns the production facilities is a “secondary issue.”

The China‑affiliated WeChat public account “Niu Danqin” explained on the 27th that, in plain language, the statement means: the factory can belong to you, but the machines must run in my country, the workers must be paid here, and it doesn’t matter who the boss is.

Even more interesting, he added a kicker: Europe should allow Chinese electric cars to be sold, but should mimic the old China‑joint‑venture model, using subsidy rules to force Chinese automakers to move their production lines to Europe.
It seems Germans are trying hard to learn from the Chinese!
“Niu Danqin” said that the masters who once taught the Chinese hand‑by‑hand are now copying China’s playbook – perhaps the most subtle reversal of the times.
Describing the scene as “a roar of protest” is actually an understatement. What really blew up were Schularick’s peers in the German automotive circle.
Ferdinand Dudenhöffer, hailed as one of the “pope” figures of German automotive economics, retorted with a German proverb: it’s like “sending an owl to Athens.”
Owls are everywhere in Athens; there’s no need to ship one over from afar.
His point was that the root of the problem is obvious to everyone, so why do you need an economist to “discover” it?

Dudenhöffer grew increasingly blunt, turning Schularick’s proposal into a clearance‑sale ad: Volkswagen, Porsche, Audi, Škoda, Cupra, MAN, Scania, plus Volkswagen commercial vehicles – “a whole bundle, sold cheap to China,” and he added, “maybe throw in a few more machinery manufacturers.”
The German word he used, “verhökern,” is not a neutral “sell,” but carries the connotation of a cheap, street‑vendor dump‑sale.
In Chinese slang it would be: “selling the calf’s field without a second thought.”
Another heavyweight, Stefan Braecher, head of the German Automotive Management Center, summed it up briefly but forcefully: selling Volkswagen to China is “a surrender in industrial policy.”

items.title: 3.4%→4.3%！川普怒轟GDP數據「蓄意誤導」：為何期中大選前不早說？必須徹查
items.title_en: 3.4%→4.3%! Trump Slams GDP Data as ‘Deliberate Deception’: Why Not Reveal It Before the Midterms? A Full Investigation Needed
paras: 美國總統川普週四(26日)在Truth Social上發文要求對美國商務部經濟分析局(BEA)最新GDP數據修正展開調查，並無端影射選前經濟統計遭「蓄意操弄」，意圖為共和黨在期中選舉慘敗找藉口。
BEA前一日公布經濟成長修正數據顯示，美國今年第三季GDP年化成長率由初值3.4%大幅上修至4.3%，創三年最快紀錄，上修主因在投資加速與政府支出回升，出口下滑則部分抵銷增幅。
對此川普猛批：「為何不在大選前公布正確數據？這不是小錯，是巨大且蓄意的錯誤，要求立即調查。」
川普還在另一篇感恩節長文諷刺統計機構「遲了三週才更正」，將矛頭指向政敵，但未提出任何人為操縱證據。
事實上，GDP初值本就依部分調查與估算發布，後續依完整數據修正是常態，此次0.9個百分點修正約為歷史平均的兩倍，但遠非「創紀錄」。
分析指出，共和黨失利主因在美伊戰爭與關稅政策推升通膨，選民體感疲弱，《美聯社》民調顯示76%選民認為經濟不佳，如今亮眼GDP反成政治火藥，官方數據公信力再受考驗。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump posted on Truth Social on Thursday (the 26th) demanding an investigation into the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) for revising the latest GDP figures, insinuating that pre‑election economic statistics were “deliberately manipulated” to give the Republican Party an excuse for its crushing loss in the midterm elections.

The BEA released revised growth data the day before, showing that the annualized GDP growth rate for the third quarter was sharply upgraded from an initial 3.4% to 4.3%, the fastest pace in three years. The upward revision was driven mainly by faster investment and a rebound in government spending, while a decline in exports partially offset the gain.
Trump blasted the revision, asking, “Why wasn’t the correct data released before the election? This isn’t a small mistake—it’s a huge, deliberate error. An immediate investigation is required.”

In another lengthy Thanksgiving‑time post, Trump mocked the statistical agency for “taking three weeks to correct” the numbers, directing blame at political opponents but offering no evidence of any human tampering.

In fact, the initial GDP estimate is always based on partial surveys and estimates, and it is routine for the figure to be revised once complete data are available. The 0.9‑percentage‑point upward adjustment is about twice the historical average, but it is far from a “record‑breaking” change.

Analysts say the Republican defeat stems mainly from the Iraq war and tariff policies that have stoked inflation, leaving voters feeling the economy is weak. An Associated Press poll shows 76% of voters think the economy is poor, and the surprisingly strong GDP reading now becomes political tinder, further testing the credibility of official data.

items.title: 川普：已敦促俄羅斯儘快達成協議
items.title_en: Trump: Urged Russia to Reach an Agreement Quickly
paras: 美國總統川普26日在社交媒體發文，稱他日前在與俄羅斯總統普丁的會談中敦促他儘快與烏克蘭達成協議，結束烏克蘭戰爭。
川普說，他堅信「這很有可能實現」，並稱「俄烏若能達成協議，那將是對所有人的一大貢獻」。
川普表示，他25日晚在佛羅里達州海湖莊園會見北約（NATO）秘書長呂特時，通報了他與普丁的談話內容。
當天早些時候，川普稱，他在同呂特會見時重點討論了烏克蘭戰爭及伊朗戰事，強調俄烏雙方應避免採取任何可能導致戰火升級的行動，同時應儘快通過和平方式解決這場衝突。
此外，烏克蘭空軍26日在社交媒體發文，稱25日晚至26日上午俄羅斯軍隊使用飛彈和無人機對境內多地發動襲擊，造成人員傷亡。

paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump posted on social media on the 26th, saying that during his recent talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin he urged him to reach an agreement with Ukraine as soon as possible to end the war in Ukraine.
Trump said he firmly believes "this is very likely to happen" and added that "if Russia and Ukraine can reach an agreement, it would be a huge contribution for everyone."
Trump said that on the evening of the 25th, while at his Mar-a-Lago estate in Florida, he briefed NATO Secretary‑General Jens Stoltenberg on his conversation with Putin.

Earlier that day, Trump said that during his meeting with Stoltenberg he focused on the war in Ukraine and the conflict with Iran, emphasizing that both Russia and Ukraine should avoid any actions that could escalate the fighting and should resolve the conflict by peaceful means as quickly as possible.

In addition, the Ukrainian Air Force posted on social media on the 26th that Russian forces used missiles and drones to attack multiple locations inside Ukraine from the night of the 25th to the morning of the 26th, causing casualties.

The Ukrainian Air Force said that 26 sites in the country were hit, with Russian forces launching Iskander‑M ballistic missiles, Zircon hypersonic missiles and 113 drones from the Belgorod and Kursk regions into Ukrainian territory.

items.title: 美管制從晶片伸向「雲端後門」！ 輝達暫停向新加坡、馬來西亞、泰國與印尼供應AI伺服器
items.title_en: U.S. Export Controls Extend from Chips to "Cloud Backdoors"; Nvidia Halts AI Server Shipments to Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Indonesia
paras: 美國出口管制之網正從「晶片實體」緊縮到「海外算力最終使用者」，外媒最新報導指出，輝達(NVDA-US) 已通知戴爾、美超微等AI伺服器廠商，暫停向馬來西亞、新加坡、泰國、印尼發運搭載其AI晶片的伺服器，相關訂單目前無法交貨，恢復時點未定。輝達與夥伴正重新梳理合規流程，以對接華府新規。
《金融時報》報導，美國商務部已在上周一(16日)發布臨時最終規則，向新馬泰印及巴西出口、再出口先進計算晶片須獲許可，同時新增「遠程算力」條款，海外資料中心若向中國等受限制實體提供超過1200萬TPP(約750顆H100/H200)的聚合算力，同樣觸發許可，存量客戶有90天過渡期補件。
美方此舉等於堵死「晶片不進中國、但中企租海外機房調用」的曲線路徑，雲端服務商須做股權穿透、終端用途盡調，紅旗原則下「說不清客戶是誰」即推定知情。
東南亞是輝達高成長市場，去年新加坡子公司帳面營收1040億美元、年增72%(含部分台灣業務，非純本地銷售)，如今供應鏈急凍，衝擊直接傳導以下三大領域：
供應端：合作廠商停接新單，擔心高價GPU板卡變庫存
項目端：接近完工機房因晶片不到貨、客戶合規未明，投產將延期
融資端：星展、華僑、大華等東南亞銀行要求相關客戶補披露，貸款審批放緩。
對此，惠譽周四(26日)警告，亞太資料中心投資將降速，專租AI算力的新興雲廠(Neocloud)壓力最大，高利用率才能涵蓋GPU租金，晶片斷供即現金流失血。
短期來看，馬來西亞、泰國依賴中國客戶的項目受創最重，新加坡需自證「可信樞紐」地位；部分伺服器廠已把拓展重心轉向日韓等未列名市場，中國則加速佈局超微MI系列與國產替代，但萬卡集群互聯與軟件生態仍需時間。
paras_en: U.S. export controls are shifting from "physical chips" to "overseas compute end users," and foreign media reports that Nvidia (NVDA-US) has told Dell, Supermicro and other AI server makers to pause shipments of servers equipped with its AI chips to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia. The related orders cannot be delivered at present, and the resumption date is uncertain. Nvidia and its partners are re‑examining compliance procedures to align with the new Washington rules.

The Financial Times reported that the U.S. Department of Commerce issued a temporary final rule last Monday (the 16th) requiring licenses for exporting or re‑exporting advanced computing chips to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil, and added a "remote compute" provision. Overseas data centers that provide more than 12 million TPP (about 750 H100/H200 units) of aggregated compute to restricted entities in China and elsewhere will also trigger licensing, with existing customers given a 90‑day transition period to submit additional paperwork.

The move effectively blocks the workaround of "chips not entering China, but Chinese firms renting overseas data centers," forcing cloud providers to conduct equity‑level due diligence and end‑use verification. Under a red‑flag principle, any inability to identify the ultimate customer is presumed to be willful ignorance.

Southeast Asia is a high‑growth market for Nvidia; last year its Singapore subsidiary reported $104 billion in revenue, up 72% year‑on‑year (including some Taiwan business and not purely local sales). The sudden supply‑chain freeze now directly impacts three major areas:
Supply side: partner manufacturers are halting new orders, fearing that high‑priced GPU boards will become excess inventory.
Project side: data centers near completion are delayed because chips are unavailable and customer compliance status is unclear, pushing back production start‑ups.
Financing side: banks such as DBS, OCBC and UOB in Southeast Asia are demanding additional disclosures from affected customers, slowing loan approvals.

Fitch warned on Thursday (the 26th) that investment in Asia‑Pacific data centers will decelerate, with emerging AI‑only cloud operators like Neocloud facing the greatest pressure; only high utilization can cover GPU rental costs, and a chip supply cut would immediately bleed cash flow.

In the short term, projects in Malaysia and Thailand that depend on Chinese customers are hit hardest, while Singapore must prove its "trusted hub" status. Some server makers are shifting focus to untapped markets such as Japan and South Korea, and China is accelerating deployment of AMD’s MI series and domestic alternatives, though large‑scale GPU cluster interconnects and software ecosystems will still take time.

items.title: 俄羅斯發動大規模襲擊 烏克蘭26處遭襲
items.title_en: Russia Launches Large-Scale Attack, Ukraine Reports 26 Sites Hit
paras: 烏克蘭空軍26日在社交媒體發文，稱25日晚至26日上午俄羅斯軍隊使用飛彈和無人機對境內多地發動襲擊，造成人員傷亡。
烏克蘭空軍說，境內26處地點遭襲，俄軍從布良斯克州和庫爾斯克州向境內發射「伊斯坎德爾-M」彈道飛彈、「鋯石」高超音速飛彈和113架無人機。
烏克蘭國家緊急情況局說，截至26日上午，俄軍空襲已造成基輔市7人受傷，有建築物受損起火。
哈爾科夫市市長捷列霍夫26日表示，該市一棟15層居民樓遭無人機襲擊，已造成2人死亡、3人受傷，仍有人員被困在廢墟內。
第聶伯羅彼得羅夫斯克州軍事管理局局長甘扎26日稱，該州遭大規模空襲，加油站、購物中心、倉庫等多處設施受損起火，造成1人受傷。
俄羅斯國防部當地時間25日表示，過去一天內，俄軍攻擊149個區域內的目標，包括烏軍使用的能源和交通基礎設施、烏方軍工設施，及烏軍和外國雇傭兵臨時部署點等。
俄羅斯防空系統共攔截和擊落863架烏克蘭固定翼無人機。
烏克蘭武裝部隊總參謀部同一天稱，過去一天前線發生203次戰鬥。空軍、飛彈部隊和炮兵打擊俄羅斯人員和裝備集結區。國防力量對俄羅斯下諾夫哥羅德州一軍用機場發動打擊，初步消息顯示5架俄軍戰機受損。
paras_en: The Ukrainian Air Force posted on social media on the 26th, saying that from the night of the 25th to the morning of the 26th Russian forces used missiles and drones to strike multiple locations inside the country, causing casualties.

The Ukrainian Air Force said that 26 sites inside Ukraine were hit, with Russian forces launching Iskander‑M ballistic missiles, Zircon hypersonic missiles and 113 drones from the Belgorod and Kursk regions.
Ukraine’s State Emergency Service said that as of the morning of the 26th the Russian air raids had injured seven people in Kyiv and caused damage and fires to buildings.
Kharkiv mayor Ihor Terekhov said on the 26th that a 15‑storey residential building in the city was hit by a drone, killing two people, injuring three and leaving others trapped in the rubble.

Dmytro Ganza, head of the military administration of the Dnipropetrovsk region, said on the 26th that the region suffered a large‑scale air raid, with fuel stations, a shopping centre, warehouses and other facilities damaged and set on fire, resulting in one injury.

The Russian Ministry of Defence said on the 25th local time that in the past day Russian forces attacked targets in 149 districts, including energy and transport infrastructure used by Ukrainian forces, Ukrainian defence‑industry facilities, and temporary deployment sites of Ukrainian troops and foreign mercenaries.
Russian air‑defence systems intercepted and shot down a total of 863 Ukrainian fixed‑wing drones.

The Ukrainian Armed Forces General Staff said on the same day that there were 203 combat incidents on the front line in the past 24 hours. The air force, missile units and artillery struck Russian personnel and equipment concentrations, and the defence forces hit a Russian military airfield in Nizhny Novgorod region, with preliminary reports indicating five Russian aircraft were damaged.

paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國經濟第三季增速創三年最快及10月通貨膨脹率進一步上升，強化美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)在12月及明年初升息的預期，但週四亞洲股市反彈，顯示美國新關稅的破壞未如最初擔憂，感恩節假期也為飽受人工智能(AI)交易降溫困擾的市場提供喘息，令美元受阻；此外，日本央行(BOJ)審議委員田村直樹稱，中東局勢不確定、日圓走勢及AI相關商品需求仍強，價格走勢表明通貨膨脹存在上行風險，BOJ必須對通貨膨脹超標迅速作反應，包括加快升息，而且世邦衛理仕(CBRE)數據顯示，全球資金持續流入日本房地產市場，第三季日本商業地產投資額較去年同期增長4%達創紀錄2.21兆日圓，海外投資人購入金額則較上年同期增30%至7,750億日圓，提供日圓支撐，美元兌日圓下滑至158.93低點。

隨著BOJ財務報告顯示，因支付存放央行的超額準備金利息增加，在截至明年3月的本財政年上半年，BOJ淨利潤下降，並據日本財務省官員稱，若市場需求強勁而在2027財政年增加整體公債發行規模，可能增加發行短期公債，而且市場對AI相關交易的擔憂加劇，衝擊全球股市，料帶給日本首相高市早苗的經濟增長計畫壓力，並預計BOJ在12月會議進行今年第三次升息，但對此後加息的速度和幅度的信心減弱，令日圓承壓，美元兌日圓回升至159.34高點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於159.30，支撐於158.40-60。
◆EUR/USD
昨日澳洲統計局數據顯示，因數據中心投資激增，澳洲第三季企業投資再大幅成長12.27%，創2011年礦業繁榮時期以來最大增幅，企業更進一步上調近期投資計畫，而且掉期市場目前顯示紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)加息25個基點至3%的概率為80%，並預期到明年年底前將累計升息75個基點，激勵澳幣和紐元回升，帶動歐元兌美元穩守1.0956低點。

隨後據紐倫堡市場決策研究所(NIM)和GfK市場研究機構調查，德國12月消費者信心指數升0.7點至負30.2優於預期，而且歐洲央行(ECB)公布歐元區10月對家庭貸款增速維持3.1%不變，但對非金融企業貸款較去年同期增4.5%，為2023年4月以來最快增速，進一步表明經濟在能源價格高企下仍保持韌性，在美國感恩節假期交投清淡之際，提振歐元兌美元至1.0988高點。預估今日歐元兌美元支撐於1.0940-60，阻力於1.1020-40。
◆GBP/USD

此前葉門胡塞組織宣稱襲擊沙烏地阿拉伯最大煉油廠，至少兩艘船在荷姆茲海峽觸雷，週四引發油價連續第三個交易日上漲，通貨膨脹壓力升高打壓英鎊兌美元至1.3092低點。隨後英國央行(BOE)在半年度金融穩定報告指出，全球借貸成本上升、中東衝突持續及AI超大規模企業今年料發行逾3,000億美元債券，加劇近期全球金融體系面臨的風險，但市場風險偏好回升，而且美元在美國感恩節假期稍作出喘息，扶助英鎊兌美元反彈至1.3124高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元支撐於1.3070-90，阻力於1.3160-80。

CBRE data show global capital continues to flow into Japan’s real‑estate market, with Q3 commercial‑property investment up 4% year‑on‑year to a record ¥2.21 trillion, and overseas investors’ purchases up 30% to ¥775 billion, supporting the yen and pulling USD/JPY down to a low of 158.93.
